title: Acts 7:20
text: "In this time Moses was born, a divinely beautiful child, who was brought up for three months in his father's house.

title: Acts 7:21
text: "When he was exposed, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and brought him up as her own son.

title: Acts 7:22
text: "So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in his words and works.

title: Acts 7:23
text: "And when he was forty years old it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel;

title: Acts 7:24
text: "and when he saw one of them wronged he wrought redress for the one overpowered, by striking down the Egyptian.

title: Acts 7:25
text: "(Now he supposed that his brothers would understand how God by his hand was bringing them deliverance; but they did not.)

title: Acts 7:26
text: "Next day he came upon two of them fighting, and tried to make peace between them. "`Sirs,' he said, `you are brothers. Why are you wronging each other?'

title: Acts 7:27
text: "But the man who was ill-treating his neighbor thrust him aside, saying, "`Who made you a magistrate and ruler over us?

title: Acts 7:28
text: "`Do you want to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?'

title: Acts 7:29
text: "Alarmed at this question, Moses fled from the land, and went to live in the land of Midian. There he became the father of two sons.

title: Acts 7:30
text: "But at the end of forty years there appeared to him, in the desert of Mt. Sinai, an angel in a flame of fire, in a bush.

title: Acts 7:31
text: "When Moses saw it he was astonished at the sight. But when he drew near to look, the voice of the Lord said,

title: Acts 7:32
text: "I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. "And Moses trembled and dared not gaze.

title: Acts 7:33
text: "And the Lord said: "Take off your sandals, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground.

title: Acts 7:34
text: "Truly I have seen the oppression of my people in Egypt, and I have heard their groans, and am come down to rescue them; and now, come, I will send you into Egypt.

title: Acts 7:35
text: "This Moses whom they refused when they said, Who made you to be a ruler and a judge? that same Moses we find God sending as a ruler and a redeemer by the hand in the bush.

title: Acts 7:36
text: "This was he who brought them out, after he had shown signs and wonders in the wilderness, for forty years.

title: Acts 7:37
text: "It was this Moses who said to the Children of Israel, "God will raise up a Prophet for you from among your brothers, as he did me.

title: Acts 7:38
text: "This is the one who was in the congregation in the wilderness along with the angel who spoke to him in Mt. Sinai, and with our ancestors to whom he gave living words to hand down to us.

title: Acts 7:39
text: "To him our ancestors would not be obedient, but thrust him aside, and in their hearts turned back into Egypt.

title: Acts 7:40
text: "Said they to Aaron: "Make Gods for us who shall march in front of us! As for this Moses who led us forth out of the land of Egypt, we know not what has happened to him.

title: Acts 7:41
text: "And they made a calf in those days, and offered a sacrifice to this idol, and began to rejoice over what they had made with their hands.

title: Acts 7:42
text: "So God turned from them, and gave them up to the worship of the heavenly host, as it is written in the book of the Prophets: "Did you offer unto me slain beasts as sacrifices during the forty years in the wilderness, O House of Israel?

title: Acts 7:43
text: No, it was the Tabernacle of Moloch and the star-symbol of the god Rempha that you lifted up--the images which you made in order to worship them; so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

title: Acts 7:44
text: "In the wilderness our ancestors had the Tabernacle of Testimony built, as he appointed who told Moses to make it according to the pattern he had seen.

title: Acts 7:45
text: "That tabernacle was brought in by our ancestors, in their turn, when they under Joshua entered on the possession of the nations whom God thrust out before them, until the days of David.

title: Acts 7:46
text: "David obtained favor with God, and asked permission to find a dwelling-place for the God of Jacob.

title: Acts 7:47
text: "But it was Solomon who built him a house.

title: Acts 7:48
text: "Yet the Most High does not dwell in houses made with hands; as said the prophet:

title: Acts 7:49
text: "The heaven is my throne, And the earth the footstool of my feet; What kind of house will you build for me? saith the Lord. Or what resting-place shall I have?

title: Acts 7:50
text: Did not my hand make this universe?

title: Acts 7:51
text: "Stiff-necked, uncircumcised in heart and ears! You are always resisting the Holy Ghost! As your fathers did, so do you.

title: Acts 7:52
text: "Which of the prophets did not your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, whose betrayers and murderers you have now become--

title: Acts 7:53
text: "you who received the law, given through angels, and obeyed it not."

title: Acts 7:54
text: As they heard these words they became furious and gnashed their teeth at him.

title: Acts 7:55
text: But he, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

title: Acts 7:56
text: "Look, I see heaven open," he said, "And the Son of man standing at the right hand of God."

title: Acts 7:57
text: With a loud outcry they stopped their ears, and rushed upon Stephen in a body,

title: Acts 7:58
text: dragged him outside the city, and stoned him, the witnesses throwing off their outer garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

title: Acts 7:59
text: So they stoned Stephen while he prayed, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."

title: Acts 7:60
text: Then he knelt down and cried aloud, "Lord, lay not this sin to their charge."

title: Acts 8:1
text: With these words he fell asleep. And Saul fully approved of his murder. On this very day there broke out a great persecution against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostle were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.

title: Acts 8:2
text: Devout men buried Stephen, and made loud lamentations over him.

title: Acts 8:3
text: But Saul was laying waste the church. He was wont to enter into every house, and to drag off men and women, and to commit them to prison.

title: Acts 8:4
text: So those who were scattered abroad were going everywhere preaching the word.

title: Acts 8:5
text: Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and began to preach Christ there.

title: Acts 8:6
text: The crowd with one accord were giving heed to what he said, when they heard and saw the signs that he did.

title: Acts 8:7
text: For with a loud cry unclean spirits would come out of many possessed by them, and many that were palsied and lame were healed.

title: Acts 8:8
text: There began to be great joy in that city.

title: Acts 8:9
text: Now for some time a man named Simon had been practising sorcery in that city, and had amazed the people of Samaria. He gave himself out to be some great person.

title: Acts 8:10
text: Many from all classes would give heed to him, declaring, "This man is the Power of God, known as the Great Power."

title: Acts 8:11
text: They were giving heed to him because, for a long time, he had amazed them with his sorceries.

title: Acts 8:12
text: But when they believed Philip, who was preaching glad tidings about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they began to be baptized, both men and women.

title: Acts 8:13
text: And Simon himself also believed, and after his baptism he remained with Philip, and was full of amazement as he beheld the signs and striking miracles which were performed.

title: Acts 8:14
text: The apostle at Jerusalem, when they heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, sent to them Peter and John.

title: Acts 8:15
text: Who came down and prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit,

title: Acts 8:16
text: For he had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

title: Acts 8:17
text: Then the apostles laid their hands upon them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 8:18
text: But when Simon perceived that, by the laying on of the apostles' hands, the Spirit was given, he offered them money saying,

title: Acts 8:19
text: "Give me, too, this power, so that on whomever I lay my hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit."

title: Acts 8:20
text: But Peter said to him: "Your money perish with you, because you have supposed that with money you can obtain God's free gift!"

title: Acts 8:21
text: "You have no part or lot in this matter." Your heart is not right in the sight of God.

title: Acts 8:22
text: Repent then of this your wickedness, and beseech the Lord to forgive you this purpose of your heart.

title: Acts 8:23
text: "For I perceive that you still stand in the gall of bitterness and in the bondage of unrighteousness."

title: Acts 8:24
text: And Simon answered, "Pray to the Lord for me, both of you, that nothing which you have said may happen to me."

title: Acts 8:25
text: So the apostles, after bearing solemn witness, and declaring the message of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, evangelizing many Samaritan villages as they went.

title: Acts 8:26
text: And an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, "Arise and go on your way south, along the road that runs down from Jerusalem to Gaza, the desert way."

title: Acts 8:27
text: So he arose and went. And behold an Ethiopian man, a eunuch, who was a high official (a chief treasurer) of Candace, the queen of Ethiopia, who had come to Jerusalem to worship

title: Acts 8:28
text: Was now on his way home, and was reading the Prophet Isaiah as he sat in his chariot.

title: Acts 8:29
text: And the Spirit said to Philip, "Go up and join that chariot."

title: Acts 8:30
text: So Philip ran up, and heard him reading Isaiah the Prophet, and said to him: "Do you understand what you are reading?"

title: Acts 8:31
text: The eunuch answered, "Why, how can I unless someone shall show me the way?" And he begged Philip to get up and sit with him.

title: Acts 8:32
text: Now the portion of Scripture which he was reading was as follows: He was led a sheep to the slaughter; And as a lamb before its shearer is dumb, So he opened not his mouth:

title: Acts 8:33
text: In his humiliation justice was denied him. Who will declare his posterity? For his life is cut off from the earth.

title: Acts 8:34
text: "Pray," asked the eunuch of Philip, "of whom is the prophet speaking? Of himself, or of some one else?"

title: Acts 8:35
text: Then Philip opened his lips, and beginning from that same scripture, he preached the gospel of Jesus to him.

title: Acts 8:36
text: And as they were going on their way they came to a certain water, and the eunuch said: "See, here is water! What hinders my being baptized?"

title: Acts 8:37
text: And Philip said, "If you believe with your whole heart, you may." The eunuch answered, "I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God."

title: Acts 8:38
text: And he ordered the chariot to stop; and both of them, Philip and the eunuch, went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

title: Acts 8:39
text: And when they had come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord snatched Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more, but continued on his way rejoicing.

title: Acts 8:40
text: Philip found himself at Ashdod. Then visiting town after town, he kept preaching the good news in all the cities until he reached Caesarea.

title: Acts 9:1
text: Meanwhile Saul, still breathing out threats of murder against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

title: Acts 9:2
text: and begged of him letters addressed to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any that were of the Way, either men or women, he could bind them and bring them to Jerusalem.

title: Acts 9:3
text: And as he journeyed, when he was approaching Damascus, suddenly a light from heaven flashed round him.

title: Acts 9:4
text: He fell to the ground, and heard a voice which said to him, "Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?"

title: Acts 9:5
text: And he said, "Who are you Lord?"

title: Acts 9:6
text: "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting," he said. "Stand up and go into the city, and there you shall be told what you must do."

title: Acts 9:7
text: Meanwhile the men who were his fellow travelers stood speechless, hearing indeed the voice, but beholding no one.

title: Acts 9:8
text: And Saul got up from the ground, but although his eyes were open, he continued to perceive nothing; so they took him by the hand and led him into Damascus.

title: Acts 9:9
text: And he remained there three days, seeing nothing, and without eating or drinking.

title: Acts 9:10
text: Now there was in Damascus a disciple named Ananias, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision, saying, "Ananias!" And he answered, "Lo, I am here, Lord."

title: Acts 9:11
text: And the Lord said to him: "Arise, go into the street named `Straight,' and make inquiries in the house of Judas for a man of Tarsus, one Saul.

title: Acts 9:12
text: He is now praying, and has seen a man named Ananias enter and lay his hands on him to restore his sight."

title: Acts 9:13
text: "But, Lord," said Ananias, "I have heard from many about that man, and how much evil he did to the saints at Jerusalem!

title: Acts 9:14
text: "In this city, too, he has authority from the chief priests to arrest all those who call upon thy name."

title: Acts 9:15
text: "Go," answered the Lord, "this man is chosen instrument of mine to bear my name before the nations and their kings, and before the Children of Israel also;

title: Acts 9:16
text: "for I am going to show him all he has to suffer for the sake of my name."

title: Acts 9:17
text: And so Ananias went and entered into the house, and laying his hands on him, said, "Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, who appeared to you on your journey, has sent me that you may receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit."

title: Acts 9:18
text: Instantly something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

title: Acts 9:19
text: Afterward he took food and was strengthened. And he remained for some time with the disciples at Damascus.

title: Acts 9:20
text: And he began at once to proclaim in the synagogues Jesus as the Son of God.

title: Acts 9:21
text: His hearers were all astonished, and began to say: "Is not this the very man who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called upon the Name? Did he not come hither for the express purpose of carrying them all in chains to the high priests?"

title: Acts 9:22
text: But Saul gained more and more influence, and kept putting the Jews who lived in Damascus to confusion by his proof that Jesus was the Christ.

title: Acts 9:23
text: And when many days were fulfilled the Jews made a plot to kill Saul;

title: Acts 9:24
text: but information of their plot was given Saul, and although they kept watch day and night on the gates, in order to make away with him,

title: Acts 9:25
text: his disciples took him by night, and let him down over the wall, lowering him in a basket.

title: Acts 9:26
text: So he came to Jerusalem, and attempted to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe that he was a disciple.

title: Acts 9:27
text: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and told them how Saul had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him; and also how he had preached the Name of the Lord Jesus boldly at Damascus.

title: Acts 9:28
text: Henceforth Saul was one of them, going in and out of the city, and speaking fearlessly in the Name of the Lord.

title: Acts 9:29
text: He also used to hold conversations and debates with the Grecian Jews, but they kept trying to kill him.

title: Acts 9:30
text: When they learned this the brothers took him down to Caesarea, and then sent him forth to Tarsus.

title: Acts 9:31
text: Now throughout the whole of Judea, Galilee, and Samaria the Church continued to enjoy peace and to be spiritually built up. It was increasing in members also, as it kept walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 9:32
text: Now Peter, as he was going from town to town, came down also to the saints who lived in Lydda.

title: Acts 9:33
text: Here he found a man named Aeneas, bedridden for eight years, a paralytic.

title: Acts 9:34
text: Peter said to him: "Aeneas, Jesus Christ cures you! Rise and make your own bed!"

title: Acts 9:35
text: At once he rose to his feet. All the people of Lydda and Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

title: Acts 9:36
text: Among the disciples at Joppa was a woman named Tabitha--which may be translated Dorcas or "Gazelle"--a woman whose life was full of good works and almsgiving, which she was doing continually.

title: Acts 9:37
text: She, as it happened, was taken ill just at that time, and died. After washing her body, they laid it in an upper room.

title: Acts 9:38
text: And as Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, when they heard that Peter was there, sent two men to him with the entreaty, "Delay not to come to us."

title: Acts 9:39
text: So Peter arose and went with them. On his arrival they took him up-stairs, and all the widows stood near him, weeping, and showing him the cloaks and garments which Dorcas used to make, while she was still with them.

title: Acts 9:40
text: But Peter put them all out, and kneeled down, and prayed; and then turning to the body, he said, "Tabitha, rise!" She opened her eyes, and on seeing Peter she sat up.

title: Acts 9:41
text: Then he gave her his hand and raised her up, and after calling the saints and the widows, he gave her back to them alive.

title: Acts 9:42
text: This incident became known throughout Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

title: Acts 9:43
text: Peter stayed for some time in Joppa, lodging in the house of Simon, the tanner.

title: Acts 10:1
text: Now there was at Caesarea a man named Cornelius, a captain in the Italian regiment.

title: Acts 10:2
text: He was a devout man and God-fearing, and so were all his household. He gave many alms to the people, and constantly prayed to God.

title: Acts 10:3
text: About three o'clock one afternoon he had a vision, and distinctly saw an angel of God enter his house and say to him, "Cornelius."

title: Acts 10:4
text: He stared at him in terror, and said, "What is it, Lord?" "Your prayers and your alms have risen for a memorial before God," answered the angel;

title: Acts 10:5
text: "and now send men to Joppa and fetch one Simon, who is called Peter.

title: Acts 10:6
text: "He is staying as a guest with Simon, a tanner, whose house is near the sea."

title: Acts 10:7
text: And after the angel who was speaking to him was gone, he called two of his household servants and a devout soldier who was in constant attendance upon him,

title: Acts 10:8
text: and after telling them everything, he sent them to Joppa.

title: Acts 10:9
text: The next day, while they were still on their way and were approaching the town, about noon, Peter went up to the housetop to pray.

title: Acts 10:10
text: He had become very hungry and longed for food; but while they were preparing it, he fell into a trance.

title: Acts 10:11
text: He beheld the sky opened, and a vessel descending like an enormous sail let down to earth by four corners.

title: Acts 10:12
text: In it were all kinds of quadrupeds and creeping things of the earth, and wild birds.

title: Acts 10:13
text: A voice came to him, saying, "Rise, Peter, kill and eat."

title: Acts 10:14
text: "Not so, my Lord," answered Peter, "for I have never yet eaten anything common and unclean."

title: Acts 10:15
text: And again a second time came to him a voice, saying, "What God has cleansed you must not call common."

title: Acts 10:16
text: This happened three times; and immediately the sail was drawn up into the sky.

title: Acts 10:17
text: Now while Peter was greatly perplexed to know what the vision which he had been sent by Cornelius, and had made inquiries for the house of Simon, stood at the gate,

title: Acts 10:18
text: and called and asked whether Simon who was called Peter was lodging there.

title: Acts 10:19
text: So the Spirit said to Peter, who was still pondering over the vision:

title: Acts 10:20
text: "Three men are now looking for you. Rise, go down and go with them, nothing doubting; for it is I who have sent them."

title: Acts 10:21
text: So Peter went down to the men and said: "I am the man you are looking for. What is the reason of your coming?"

title: Acts 10:22
text: "Cornelius," they answered, "a captain, a devout man, and God-fearing, of whom the whole, Jewish nation speaks well, was instructed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house, and to listen to your message."

title: Acts 10:23
text: So he invited them in and gave them lodging. The next day he rose, and went off with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied them;

title: Acts 10:24
text: and the day after that they reached Caesarea. There Cornelius was waiting for them, and had brought together all his relatives and intimate friends.

title: Acts 10:25
text: When Peter entered the house Cornelius met him, fell at his feet, and worshiped him;

title: Acts 10:26
text: but Peter lifted him up. "Stand up," he said, "I am only a man, myself."

title: Acts 10:27
text: And as he talked with him, he went in and found a large company assembled.

title: Acts 10:28
text: To them he said: "You know, yourselves, that it is illegal for a Jew to associate with or to visit one of another nation; but God has taught me that I should not call any man common or unclean. For this reason, when sent for, I came without demur.

title: Acts 10:29
text: "I ask therefore why you sent for me."

title: Acts 10:30
text: Cornelius answered: "Three days ago, at this very hour, I was praying in my house at three o'clock in the afternoon, when suddenly a man in a shining robe stood by me,

title: Acts 10:31
text: and said: "`Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

title: Acts 10:32
text: "`So send to Joppa and summon Simon, who is called Peter. He is lodging with Simon the tanner, in a house by the seaside.'

title: Acts 10:33
text: "So I sent for you without delay, and you have been kind enough to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God, to listen to what the Lord has commanded you to speak."

title: Acts 10:34
text: Then Peter began to speak: "Of a truth I begin to see quite plainly that God is no respecter of persons;

title: Acts 10:35
text: "but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

title: Acts 10:36
text: "You cannot but know the message which he sent to the descendants of Israel, when he preached the gospel of peace by Jesus Christ who is Lord of all;

title: Acts 10:37
text: "you know the message spread throughout all Judea, beginning in Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

title: Acts 10:38
text: "how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how he went about everywhere doing good, and curing all who were oppressed by the devil; for God was with him.

title: Acts 10:39
text: "And we were witnesses of all that he did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him, hanging him on a tree.

title: Acts 10:40
text: "But him God raised up on the third day, and permitted him to be made manifest,

title: Acts 10:41
text: "not to all the people, but to witnesses--men previously chosen by God--that is, to us, who ate and drank with him after he had risen from the dead;

title: Acts 10:42
text: "when he charged us to preach to the people, and to testify that this was he whom God ordained to be the judge of the living and of the dead.

title: Acts 10:43
text: "To him all the prophets bear witness, testifying that through his name every one that believes on him will receive remission of sins."

title: Acts 10:44
text: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit fell on all who were listening to the message.

title: Acts 10:45
text: And all the Jewish believers who had accompanied Peter were amazed, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out upon the Gentiles also.

title: Acts 10:46
text: For they heard them speak with tongues and magnify God.

title: Acts 10:47
text: Then Peter said, "Can any one refuse water for the baptism of these men who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we?"

title: Acts 10:48
text: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they begged him to remain with them for a time.

title: Acts 11:1
text: Now the apostles and the brothers that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God;

title: Acts 11:2
text: so, when Peter came up to Jerusalem, the circumcision party disputed with him,

title: Acts 11:3
text: saying, "You went into the houses of the uncircumcised and ate with them!"

title: Acts 11:4
text: Then Peter began and explained the whole matter to them in order, saying:

title: Acts 11:5
text: "I was in the city of Joppa, praying, and while in a trance I saw a vision; a certain vessel descending, what seemed to be an enormous sail let down to me,

title: Acts 11:6
text: and while I gazed at it, I examined it carefully, and saw the quadrupeds of the earth and the wild beasts and creeping things and the wild birds.

title: Acts 11:7
text: I also heard a voice saying to me, `Rise, Peter, kill and eat.'

title: Acts 11:8
text: "`Not so, my Lord' said I, `for nothing common or unclean has ever gone into my mouth.'

title: Acts 11:9
text: "But for the second time a voice spoke from the sky, `What God has cleansed, you must not call common.'

title: Acts 11:10
text: "This was said three times, and then everything was drawn up again into the sky.

title: Acts 11:11
text: "And lo! at that very moment, three men who had been sent for me from Caesarea stood before the house in which I was.

title: Acts 11:12
text: "And the Spirit bade me accompany them without misgiving. There also accompanied me these six brothers, and we went into the man's house.

title: Acts 11:13
text: "Then he told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying: "`Send to Joppa and fetch Simon who is also called Peter.

title: Acts 11:14
text: "`He will speak words to you by which you and all your family will be saved.'

title: Acts 11:15
text: "And," said Peter, "as soon as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as he fell upon us at the beginning.

title: Acts 11:16
text: "Then I remembered the words of the Lord, how he used to say, "`John indeed baptized in water, but you shall be baptized in the Holy Spirit.'

title: Acts 11:17
text: "So if God gave them the same gift as he gave to us, when we first believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I that I could withstand God?"

title: Acts 11:18
text: On hearing this they held their peace and glorified God, saying, "Forsooth then, to the Gentiles also God has granted repentance unto life."

title: Acts 11:19
text: Then those who had been scattered by the trouble that arose over Stephen, traveled as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus and Antioch; but they preached the word to none except Jews.

title: Acts 11:20
text: Some of them, however, were Cyprians and Cyrenaeans, who, on reaching Antioch, began to tell the Greeks also the Good News concerning the Lord Jesus.

title: Acts 11:21
text: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number who believed turned to the Lord.

title: Acts 11:22
text: When news of this reached the ears of the church at Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas as far as Antioch.

title: Acts 11:23
text: When he arrived, and saw the grace of God, he was glad, and he encouraged them all to remain faithful to the Lord, with full purpose of heart;

title: Acts 11:24
text: for he was a good man, and full of faith and the Holy Spirit. And a great multitude was added to the Lord.

title: Acts 11:25
text: Then Barnabas visited Tarsus, to try to find Saul,

title: Acts 11:26
text: and when he had found him he brought him to Antioch, where for a whole year they were guests of the church, and taught many people. And it was in Antioch that the disciples first received the name of "Christians."

title: Acts 11:27
text: At that time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

title: Acts 11:28
text: One of them, who was Agabus, rose up, and being instructed by the Spirit, predicted that a great famine was about to come upon the whole inhabited earth. (It came in the reign of Claudius.)

title: Acts 11:29
text: So the disciples decided to send relief, every man according to his means, to the brothers in Judea.

title: Acts 11:30
text: This they did, forwarding their contributions to the elders by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.

title: Acts 12:1
text: Now, at about that time, Herod the king put forth his hands to ill-treat certain members of the church;

title: Acts 12:2
text: and beheaded James, the brother of John, with the sword.

title: Acts 12:3
text: And when he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. (This was during the days of unleavened bread.)

title: Acts 12:4
text: He had him arrested and thrown in prison, and put under guard of sixteen soldiers. He intended, after the Passover, to bring him forth to the people.

title: Acts 12:5
text: So Peter was kept in prison, but earnest prayer to God was made by the church for him.

title: Acts 12:6
text: Now when Herod was about to bring him forth, on that very night, while Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with chains, and sentries before the door were guarding the prison,

title: Acts 12:7
text: suddenly an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. Striking Peter on the side, he woke him saying, "Rise up quickly." At once the chains dropped from his hands.

title: Acts 12:8
text: "Gird yourself," said the angel, "and put on your sandals." He did so. Then he said unto him, "Throw your cloak about you, and follow me."

title: Acts 12:9
text: So Peter went out, following him, but did not realize that what the angel was doing was real, but supposed that he was seeing a vision.

title: Acts 12:10
text: And when they had passed the first guard and the second, they came to the iron gate that led to the city. This opened to them of its own accord; and they went out passed on through one street; and suddenly the angel left him.

title: Acts 12:11
text: Peter, coming to himself, said, "Now I know for a certainty that the Lord has sent his angel and released me from the hand of Herod, and from all that the Jewish people were anticipating."

title: Acts 12:12
text: So, after he had thought things over, he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John, surnamed Mark, where a large number of people were assembled, praying.

title: Acts 12:13
text: When he knocked at the door of the gate, a maid servant named Rhoda came to answer.

title: Acts 12:14
text: And when she recognized Peter's voice, for very joy she did not open the door, but ran in and told them that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

title: Acts 12:15
text: "You are mad," they said. But she confidently insisted that it was so. "It is his angel," they said.

title: Acts 12:16
text: Meanwhile Peter continued to knock, until at last they opened the door, and were amazed to see that it was really he.

title: Acts 12:17
text: He motioned to them to keep quiet, and told them how the Lord had brought him out of prison. "Tell all this to James," he said, "and to the brothers," and away he went to another place.

title: Acts 12:18
text: When morning came there was no small stir among the soldiers as to what could possibly have become of Peter.

title: Acts 12:19
text: Then Herod had search made for him, and could not find him. After sharply questioning the guards, he ordered them off to execution. He then went down from Judea to Caesarea, where he stayed for some time.

title: Acts 12:20
text: Now Herod was violently displeased with the people of Tyre and Sidon. So they came to him, with one accord, and after conciliating Blastus, the royal chamberlain, they begged for peace because their country depended upon the king's country for its food supply.

title: Acts 12:21
text: So on the appointed day, Herod put on his royal robes, and after taking his seat upon the throne, began to harangue them.

title: Acts 12:22
text: "The voice of a god, and not of a man," the people kept shouting.

title: Acts 12:23
text: Instantly an angel of the Lord smote him, because he had not given God the glory, and being eaten up by worms, he died.

title: Acts 12:24
text: But the word of God grew and multiplied;

title: Acts 12:25
text: and after discharging their mission, Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, bringing with them John, surnamed Mark.

title: Acts 13:1
text: Now there were in the church in Antioch prophets and teachers; Barnabas and Symeon, surnamed "the Black," Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen, the foster-brother of Herod the Tetrarch, and Saul.

title: Acts 13:2
text: And as they were worshiping the Lord, and fasting, the Holy Spirit said to them, "Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."

title: Acts 13:3
text: So after fasting and praying, they laid their hands on them, and let them go.

title: Acts 13:4
text: So they, sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia, and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

title: Acts 13:5
text: And while they were in Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews.

title: Acts 13:6
text: They had John Mark as an assistant; and after going through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a certain Jewish sorcerer and false prophet, named Bar-Jesus,

title: Acts 13:7
text: who belonged to the suite of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man. He summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

title: Acts 13:8
text: But Elymas, "the sorcerer," for that is the translation of his name, opposed them, and tried to divert the proconsul from the faith.

title: Acts 13:9
text: So Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, gazed steadily at him, and said:

title: Acts 13:10
text: "O full of all craft and cunning, you son of the devil! You enemy of all goodness! Will you never stop perverting the right ways of the Lord?

title: Acts 13:11
text: "The Lord's hand is now upon you, and you shall be blind, not seeing the sun for a season." Instantly there fell on him a mist and a darkness, and groping about, he sought some one to lead him by the hand.

title: Acts 13:12
text: Then the proconsul, seeing what had happened, believed. He was astounded at the teaching of the Lord.

title: Acts 13:13
text: From Paphos Paul and his party set sail for Perga in Pamphylia; but John [Mark] left them and went back to Jerusalem.

title: Acts 13:14
text: Then they themselves, passing through from Perga, came to Antioch in Pisidia. Here they went into the synagogue on the Sabbath Day and sat down.

title: Acts 13:15
text: And, after the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the wardens of the synagogue sent word to them: "Brothers," they said, "if you have any word of encouragement to the people, say it."

title: Acts 13:16
text: So Paul stood up, and motioning with his hand, said: "Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

title: Acts 13:17
text: "The God of this people of Israel chose our forefathers and made this people great, while they sojourned in the land of Egypt. And with an uplifted arm he led them out of it.

title: Acts 13:18
text: "For about forty years he bore with them in the desert,

title: Acts 13:19
text: "and when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land as an inheritance for about four hundred and fifty years.

title: Acts 13:20
text: "And afterwards he gave them Judges, until Samuel, the prophet.

title: Acts 13:21
text: "Then they asked for a king, and he gave them Saul, the son of Kish, a Benjamite for forty years.

title: Acts 13:22
text: After deposing him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also bore witness, when he said, "I have found David, the son of Jesse, a man after my own heart, and who will obey all my will.

title: Acts 13:23
text: "Of this man's descendants God has brought unto Israel, according to his promise, a Savior, Jesus;

title: Acts 13:24
text: "before whose coming John had already preached a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

title: Acts 13:25
text: "And John, when he was finishing his race, repeatedly asked the people: "`Who do you suppose that I am? I am not He. But behold there comes One after me, whose sandal I am not worthy to unfasten.'

title: Acts 13:26
text: "Brothers, sons of Abraham's race, and all among you who reverence God, to us has the word of this salvation been sent.

title: Acts 13:27
text: "For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor the utterances of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

title: Acts 13:28
text: "Though they found no cause of death in him, yet they asked Pilate to put him to death.

title: Acts 13:29
text: "And when they had fulfilled everything which had been written concerning him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

title: Acts 13:30
text: "But God raised him from the dead.

title: Acts 13:31
text: "For many days he was seen by those that came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, and are now his witnesses to the people.

title: Acts 13:32
text: "And we bring you glad tidings of the promise made to our forefathers,

title: Acts 13:33
text: "how that God fulfilled it for us their children in raising up Jesus; as it is also written in the second Psalm, "Thou art my son, today have I become thy Father.

title: Acts 13:34
text: "And as to his having raised him from among the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has said this, "I will give thee the holy and sure blessings of David.

title: Acts 13:35
text: "Because in another psalm he says, "Thou wilt not give thy Holy One to see corruption.

title: Acts 13:36
text: "For David, after he had served his own generation according to the will of God, fell on sleep, and was gathered to his forefathers, and did see corruption;

title: Acts 13:37
text: but he whom God raised up saw no corruption.

title: Acts 13:38
text: "Be it known unto you therefore, brothers, that remission of sins is proclaimed to you through this man;

title: Acts 13:39
text: "and that by him every one that believes is justified from all things from which you could never be justified by the law of Moses.

title: Acts 13:40
text: "Beware, then, lest that spoken of in the prophets come upon you:

title: Acts 13:41
text: "Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish, For in your days I will do a deed, A deed which you will never believe, Though one should declare it unto you."

title: Acts 13:42
text: As Paul and Barnabas left the synagogue, the people earnestly begged that these words might be repeated to them on the following Sabbath.

title: Acts 13:43
text: When the congregation broke up, many of the Jews, and of the devout proselytes, followed Paul and Barnabas, who talked to them, and urged them to continue in the grace of God.

title: Acts 13:44
text: On the next Sabbath almost the entire city was gathered together to know the word of God.

title: Acts 13:45
text: When they saw the crowds, the Jews were filled with jealousy, and began to contradict Paul's statements, and to abuse him.

title: Acts 13:46
text: So Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly: "It was necessary," they said, "first to proclaim the word of God to you. But since you push it away from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

title: Acts 13:47
text: "For such is God's command to us, saying, "I have set thee for a light to the Gentiles, That thou shouldest be for salvation to the uttermost part of the earth."

title: Acts 13:48
text: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord, and all who had been ordained to eternal life, believed.

title: Acts 13:49
text: So the Lord's message went far and wide, through the whole district.

title: Acts 13:50
text: But the Jews urged on the devout women of high rank, and the leading citizens, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and drove them out of the district,

title: Acts 13:51
text: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

title: Acts 13:52
text: As for the disciples, they were continually filled with joy, and with the Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 14:1
text: In Iconium it happened that they went together to the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great number both of Jews and of Gentiles believed.

title: Acts 14:2
text: But the disobedient Jews stirred up the souls of the Gentiles, and embittered them against them against the brothers.

title: Acts 14:3
text: Long time, therefore, they tarried there, speaking fearlessly in the Lord, who attested the word of his grace by permitting signs and wonders to be performed by their hands.

title: Acts 14:4
text: But the mass of the city's people was divided; part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

title: Acts 14:5
text: And when both the Gentiles and the Jews with their ruler made a hostile move to maltreat and to stone them,

title: Acts 14:6
text: the apostles got wind of it, and made their escape to the Lycaonian towns of Derbe and Lystra and the neighboring country.

title: Acts 14:7
text: And there they continued to proclaim the gospel.

title: Acts 14:8
text: Now at Lystra there used to sit a certain man, lame in his feet, a cripple from birth, who had never walked.

title: Acts 14:9
text: He was listening while Paul was preaching, and Paul, looking intently at him, and perceiving that he had faith to be made whole,

title: Acts 14:10
text: said in a loud voice, "Stand upright on your feet!"

title: Acts 14:11
text: And he sprang up and began to walk about. Then the crowds, when they saw what Paul had done, shouted in the Lycaonian tongue, saying, "The gods are come down to us in human form."

title: Acts 14:12
text: And they began to call Barnabas "Zeus," and Paul, since he was the principal speaker, "Hermes";

title: Acts 14:13
text: and the priest of Zeus, whose temple was at the entrance to the city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and along with the crowds was about to offer sacrifices.

title: Acts 14:14
text: But when the apostles, Paul and Barnabas, heard of it, they rent their garments and rushed out among the crowd, shouting and crying:

title: Acts 14:15
text: "Men, why are you doing all this? We also are men, with natures like your own! We are bringing you good tidings, that you are to turn from these empty things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and the sea and all that in them is.

title: Acts 14:16
text: In bygone generations he allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways,

title: Acts 14:17
text: and yet he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness."

title: Acts 14:18
text: Even with saying this they with difficulty restrained the crowds from sacrificing to them.

title: Acts 14:19
text: And now a party of Jews came down form Antioch and Iconium, and after persuading the crowds, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing him to be dead.

title: Acts 14:20
text: But as the disciples collected around him, he rose and went back into the city. The next day he went off with Barnabas into Derbe;

title: Acts 14:21
text: and after preaching the gospel to that town, and winning many converts, they went back to Lystra and Iconium and Antioch,

title: Acts 14:22
text: Everywhere they strengthened the souls of the disciples, encouraging them to hold to the faith. "It is through many tribulations," they said, "that we must enter into the kingdom of God."

title: Acts 14:23
text: They chose elders for them in every church, after prayer and fasting, and commended them to the Lord in whom they had believed.

title: Acts 14:24
text: Then passing through Pisidia they came to Pamphylia and,

title: Acts 14:25
text: after preaching the word in Perga, they came down to Attaleia.

title: Acts 14:26
text: Thence they sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been commended to the grace of God, for the work which they had now completed.

title: Acts 14:27
text: On their arrival they assembled the church and reported all things that God had done through them, and how he had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.

title: Acts 14:28
text: And they tarried no little time with the disciples.

title: Acts 15:1
text: But some men came down from Judea and attempted to teach the brethren, saying, "Unless you are circumcised according to Moses' custom, you cannot be saved."

title: Acts 15:2
text: Now when dispute and controversy sprang up between them and Paul and Barnabas, the brethren appointed Paul and Barnabas, and certain others, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.

title: Acts 15:3
text: So the church saw them off on their journey, and they passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria. Here they set forth the conversion of the Gentiles, and brought great joy to all the brothers.

title: Acts 15:4
text: Upon their arrival in Jerusalem they were received by the church and the apostles and elders, and they told them all things that God had done with them.

title: Acts 15:5
text: But certain men who had belonged to the sect of the Pharisees, but were now believers, stood up and said, "It is necessary to circumcise Gentile, and to order them to keep the Law of Moses."

title: Acts 15:6
text: The apostles and elders met to consider the matter;

title: Acts 15:7
text: and after there had been a long discussion, Peter rose and said: "Brothers, you know how a good while ago God made choice among you, that from my lips the Gentiles were to hear the message of the gospel and believe.

title: Acts 15:8
text: "And God, who knows the hearts of all, gave this testimony in their behalf, by bestowing upon them the Holy Spirit just as he did upon us;

title: Acts 15:9
text: "and he made no distinction between us and them, in cleansing their hearts by faith.

title: Acts 15:10
text: "Now then, why are you tempting God by laying on the necks of these disciples a yoke which neither our forefathers nor we have been able to bear?

title: Acts 15:11
text: "On the contrary we believe that it is by the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ that we and they shall be saved."

title: Acts 15:12
text: Then the whole assembly remained silent, and listened to Barnabas and Saul as they told the signs and wonders which God had wrought among the Gentiles through them.

title: Acts 15:13
text: When they had finished speaking, James said:

title: Acts 15:14
text: "Brothers, listen to me. Symeon has told how God first looked graciously upon the Gentiles, to take out from among them a people to be called by his name.

title: Acts 15:15
text: "And this is in harmony with the language of the prophets, which says:

title: Acts 15:16
text: "After these things I will return, And I will rebuild David's fallen tent; And I will build again its ruins, And I will set it up;

title: Acts 15:17
text: "So that the rest of men may seek after the Lord, Even all the Gentiles, who are called by my name,

title: Acts 15:18
text: "Says the Lord, who has been making this known from the beginning of the world.

title: Acts 15:19
text: "My judgment therefore, is against troubling those who turn to God from among the Gentiles;

title: Acts 15:20
text: "but that we should write to them to abstain from the pollution of idols and from fornication, from meat killed by strangling, and from blood.

title: Acts 15:21
text: "For Moses from the earliest times has had his preachers in every town where he is read aloud, Sabbath after Sabbath, in the synagogues."

title: Acts 15:22
text: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, together with the whole church, to select some of their number, and to send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. The men chosen were Judas called Bar-Sabbas, and Silas, leading men among the brethren.

title: Acts 15:23
text: They took with them the following letter: "The apostles and older brothers send greeting to the Gentile Brotherhood throughout Antioch and Syria and Cilicia;

title: Acts 15:24
text: "as we have heard that some of your number who went out from us have troubled you with words and upset your souls, without having received any such instruction from us;

title: Acts 15:25
text: "we have unanimously decided to select certain men, and to send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul;

title: Acts 15:26
text: "men who have risked their very lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Acts 15:27
text: "So we have sent Judas and Silas to tell you the same things by word of mouth.

title: Acts 15:28
text: "For it has seemed good to the Holy Ghost and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

title: Acts 15:29
text: "that you abstain from food that has been sacrificed to idols, and from tasting blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication. Keep yourselves clear from these things and it will be well with you. Farewell."

title: Acts 15:30
text: So they, when they had been despatched, went down to Antioch, and after gathering the whole multitude together, they handed them the letter,

title: Acts 15:31
text: and when they had read it they rejoiced at the comfort it brought.

title: Acts 15:32
text: And Judas and Silas, who were themselves prophets, encouraged and strengthened the brothers with many a good counsel.

title: Acts 15:33
text: After spending some time there the brothers let them go with a greeting of peace to those who had sent them.

title: Acts 15:34
text: Silas, however, stayed with them.

title: Acts 15:35
text: Paul and Barnabas also stayed in Antioch teaching and proclaiming the word of the Lord, in company with others.

title: Acts 15:36
text: And after some days Paul said to Barnabas, "Let is go back and visit the brothers in every city in which we have proclaimed the word of the Lord. Let us see how they fare."

title: Acts 15:37
text: Now Barnabas wanted to take with them John, who was called Mark.

title: Acts 15:38
text: But Paul thought it unwise to take with them one who had deserted them to the Pamphylia, and had not gone on with them to the work.

title: Acts 15:39
text: So there arose a sharp irritation, so that they parted company; Barnabas taking Mark with him, sailed away to Cyprus;

title: Acts 15:40
text: while Paul chose Silas, and set forth commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

title: Acts 15:41
text: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

title: Acts 16:1
text: And he came also to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a certain disciple named Timothy, the son of a believing Jewess, and of a Greek father.

title: Acts 16:2
text: He was well spoken of by the brothers in Lystra and Iconiun.

title: Acts 16:3
text: Now Paul, wishing that this man should accompany him on his journey, took him and circumcised him because of the local Jews, who all knew that his father was a Greek.

title: Acts 16:4
text: And as they went on their way through the cities they handed them the resolutions which the apostles and the elders in Jerusalem had ordained for them to keep.

title: Acts 16:5
text: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and continued to increase in number daily.

title: Acts 16:6
text: Then they went through Phrygia and Galatia, the Holy Spirit having forbidden them to proclaim the message in Asia.

title: Acts 16:7
text: When they got as far as Mysia, they attempted to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not permit it;

title: Acts 16:8
text: and so they passed by Mysia and went on down to Troas.

title: Acts 16:9
text: Here a vision appeared to Paul in the night. There stood a man of Macedonia, entreating him and saying, "Come over into Macedonia and help us!"

title: Acts 16:10
text: So when he had seen the vision, we sought at once to go forth into Macedonia, because we concluded that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.

title: Acts 16:11
text: So we set sail from Troas and ran a straight course to Samothrace. The next day we arrived in Neapolis,

title: Acts 16:12
text: and thence came to Philippi, a city of Macedonia, the fore most in its district, a Roman colony. There we stayed for some time.

title: Acts 16:13
text: On the Sabbath Day we went outside the city gate, to a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer; and we sat down and talked to the women who had gathered there.

title: Acts 16:14
text: Among them was a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, who belonged to the town of Thyatira. She, since she was a worshiper of God, listened to us, and the Lord opened her heart to attend to what Paul said.

title: Acts 16:15
text: When she was baptized, and her household, she urged us, saying, "If in your judgment I am a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house." And she compelled us to come.

title: Acts 16:16
text: Now as we were going to the place of prayer, a certain slave girl met us, who had a spirit of divination, and who brought her masters great gain by fortune-telling.

title: Acts 16:17
text: She used to follow after Paul and us, crying out again and again, "These men are servants of the most high God, who proclaimed to you the way of salvation."

title: Acts 16:18
text: She persisted in this for many days, until Paul, worn out, turned round and said to the spirit, "I charge you, in the name of Jesus Christ, to come out of her." In that very hour it came out of her.

title: Acts 16:19
text: But when her owners saw that their hopes of gain were gone, they seized Paul and Silas, and dragged them before the magistrates, into the market-place.

title: Acts 16:20
text: Then they brought them before the praetors, saying: "These fellows are Jews, who are making a great disturbance in our city.

title: Acts 16:21
text: "They are teaching customs which it is not lawful for us as Romans to adopt or practise."

title: Acts 16:22
text: The crowd, too, rose up together against them, and the praetors, after having them stripped, and after ordering them to be flogged,

title: Acts 16:23
text: had many lashes inflicted upon them, and put them in prison, with a charge to the jailer to keep them safe.

title: Acts 16:24
text: On receiving so strict an order he cast them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

title: Acts 16:25
text: But at midnight, while Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them,

title: Acts 16:26
text: suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the very foundations of the prison-house were shaken; and instantly all the doors were opened, and every one's chains fell off.

title: Acts 16:27
text: The jailer, roused from sleep, and seeing the doors wide open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, because he thought that the prisoners had escaped.

title: Acts 16:28
text: But Paul shouted loudly to him: "Do yourself no harm; for we are all here!"

title: Acts 16:29
text: So he called for lights, and sprang in, and, trembling for fear, fell down before Paul and Silas,

title: Acts 16:30
text: and brought them out, saying, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"

title: Acts 16:31
text: "Believe on the Lord Jesus," they answered, "and you will be saved, you and all your household."

title: Acts 16:32
text: Then they spoke the message of the Lord to him, as well as to all who were in his house.

title: Acts 16:33
text: And he took them, the same hour of the night, and washed their wounds, and he was baptized at once, he and all his.

title: Acts 16:34
text: And after bringing them up into his house, he set food before them, overjoyed with all his household in having believed in God.

title: Acts 16:35
text: But in the morning the praetors sent their lictors with the order, "Let these men go."

title: Acts 16:36
text: The jailer reported the words to Paul, saying: "The praetors have sent to release you; so come out, and go in peace."

title: Acts 16:37
text: But Paul said: "They have flogged us publicly, uncondemned, men that are Roman citizens; and have thrown us into prison. Are they now going to get rid of us secretly? No, indeed! Let them come here, themselves and take us out."

title: Acts 16:38
text: The lictors reported these words to the praetors, who were frightened when they heard that they were Romans.

title: Acts 16:39
text: So they came and conciliated them, and after taking them out of prison, begged them to leave the town.

title: Acts 16:40
text: So Paul and Silas came out of the prison, and went to Lydia's house; and after they had seen the brethren and encouraged them, they left Philippi.

title: Acts 17:1
text: Now when they had gone through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica. Here there was a Jewish synagogue,

title: Acts 17:2
text: and Paul, according to his usual custom, went in to them and, for three Sabbath Days, he reasoned with them out of the Scriptures,

title: Acts 17:3
text: explaining and quoting passages to prove that the Messiah had to suffer and to rise again from the dead and that "This Jesus whom I am proclaiming unto you is the Messiah."

title: Acts 17:4
text: Some were persuaded and attached themselves to Paul and Silas, including a number of devout Greeks, and a large number of the leading women.

title: Acts 17:5
text: But the Jews, moved with jealousy, called to their aid certain ill-favored and idle fellows, formed a mob, and began to set the town in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

title: Acts 17:6
text: And when they had failed to find Paul and Silas, they began to drag Jason and some of the brethren before the politarchs, shouting: "These fellows who have upset the habitable earth are come hither also.

title: Acts 17:7
text: "Jason has received them, and they all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus."

title: Acts 17:8
text: Both the crowd and the politarchs were disturbed when they heard this,

title: Acts 17:9
text: but when they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

title: Acts 17:10
text: Now the brothers sent Paul and Silas away by night to Berea. When they got there they betook themselves to the Jewish synagogue.

title: Acts 17:11
text: The Jews of Berea were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they very readily received the message with all readiness of mind, and day after day searched the Scriptures to see whether these things were so.

title: Acts 17:12
text: So many of them became believers, and so did not a few Greeks, women of honorable estate, and men.

title: Acts 17:13
text: As soon as the Jews in Thessalonica learned that the word of God was preached by Paul in Berea also, they came there, and stirred up and troubled the crowds.

title: Acts 17:14
text: Then the brothers at once sent Paul down to the sea, but Silas and Timothy remained behind.

title: Acts 17:15
text: Those who were caring for Paul brought him as far as Athens, and there left him, with instructions to Silas and Timothy to come to him with all speed.

title: Acts 17:16
text: While Paul was waiting for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred within him, when he noticed that the city was full of idols.

title: Acts 17:17
text: He argued in the synagogues with the Jews and the devout proselytes, and also daily in the market-place with those that met him there.

title: Acts 17:18
text: A few of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also encountered him again and again. Some were saying, "What has this beggarly fellow to say?" Others said, "He seems to be a setter forth of strange gods," because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

title: Acts 17:19
text: Then they laid hold of him and brought him up to Mars Hill, saying: "May we be told what this new teaching of yours is?

title: Acts 17:20
text: "For you are bringing certain strange things to our ears. We want to know, therefore, what these things mean."

title: Acts 17:21
text: (Now all the Athenians and the strangers sojourning there spent their time in nothing else, but to tell or to hear some new thing.)

title: Acts 17:22
text: So Paul stood up in the center of Mars Hill, and said: "Men of Athens, I perceive that in all respects you are remarkably religious.

title: Acts 17:23
text: "For as I was passing along and observing your objects of worship, I found also an altar with this inscription, `TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.' What you are worshiping in ignorance, this I am proclaiming to you.

title: Acts 17:24
text: "The God who made the universe and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made with hands,

title: Acts 17:25
text: "neither is he served by men's hands, as though he needed anything, since he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

title: Acts 17:26
text: "He has made of one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, having determined their appointed seasons and the bounds of their habitation,

title: Acts 17:27
text: "so that they might seek God, if perhaps they might feel after him and find him, though he is not far from every on of us;

title: Acts 17:28
text: "for in him we live and move and have our being; as certain even of your own poets have said, "`For we also are his offspring.'

title: Acts 17:29
text: "Since then we are God's offspring, we ought not to imagine that the Godhead is like to gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and device of man.

title: Acts 17:30
text: "The times of ignorance God overlooked, but he now commands all men that they should all, everywhere, repent;

title: Acts 17:31
text: inasmuch as he has fixed a day in which he will judge the world justly, by the Man whom he has ordained, and he has given proof of all this by raising him from the dead."

title: Acts 17:32
text: But on hearing of the resurrection of the dead, some began to mock; but others said, "We will hear you again on that subject."

title: Acts 17:33
text: So Paul withdrew from them.

title: Acts 17:34
text: A few, however, attached themselves to him and believed, among whom was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and some others.

title: Acts 18:1
text: After this Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

title: Acts 18:2
text: Here he found a certain Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife, Priscilla, because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome.

title: Acts 18:3
text: Paul came to them, and because he was of the same trade with them, he lodged with them, and worked with them--for by trade they were tentmakers.

title: Acts 18:4
text: Every Sabbath he used to preach in the synagogue, and tried to persuade both Jews and Greeks.

title: Acts 18:5
text: And when Silas and Timothy arrived from Macedonia, Paul was engrossed in his message, earnestly testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah.

title: Acts 18:6
text: But as they opposed him and abused him, he shook out his garments in protest, and said: "Your blood be upon your own hands. I am clean. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."

title: Acts 18:7
text: So he left the place, and went into the house of a man named Titus Justus, a worshiper of God, whose house adjoined the synagogue.

title: Acts 18:8
text: And Crispus, the warden of the synagogue, believed on the Lord, with all his household; and many of the Corinthians from time to time listened, believed, and were baptized.

title: Acts 18:9
text: And the Lord said to Paul in a vision, by night: "Have no fear; go on speaking, and do not keep silent;

title: Acts 18:10
text: "for I am with you, and no one shall set upon you to injure you; for I have very many people in this city."

title: Acts 18:11
text: So he lived there a year and six months and continued to teach them the word of God.

title: Acts 18:12
text: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose against Paul, and brought him before the tribunal.

title: Acts 18:13
text: "This fellow," they said, "is persuading men to offer unlawful worship to God."

title: Acts 18:14
text: Paul was about to open his mouth, when Gallio said to the Jews: "If it had been some misdemeanor or wicked villainy, it would have been within reason for me to listen to you Jews;

title: Acts 18:15
text: but as these are merely questions about words and names and your own law, you yourselves must see to it. I am not willing to be a judge of these matters."

title: Acts 18:16
text: And he drove them from the tribunal.

title: Acts 18:17
text: Then they all laid hold of Sosthenes, the warden of the synagogue, and beat him in front of the tribunal; but Gallio took no notice.

title: Acts 18:18
text: And Paul after remaining in Corinth some time longer, took leave of the brothers, and sailed away to Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. As Paul was under a vow, he had his head shaved at Cenchrea.

title: Acts 18:19
text: When they came to Ephesus he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

title: Acts 18:20
text: When they begged him to stay longer, he would not consent,

title: Acts 18:21
text: but said, as he took leave of them, "I will return again to you, if God will."

title: Acts 18:22
text: Then, setting sail from Ephesus, he landed at Caesarea; he went up to Jerusalem and saluted the church, and came down to Antioch.

title: Acts 18:23
text: After spending some time there, he set out and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, and strengthened all the disciples.

title: Acts 18:24
text: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, a learned man and mighty in the Scriptures, came to Ephesus.

title: Acts 18:25
text: He had been instructed in the ways of the Lord, and being full of zeal, he used to speak and to teach accurately the facts about Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

title: Acts 18:26
text: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue; and when Priscilla and Aquila heard him they took him home and explained to him more accurately the way of God.

title: Acts 18:27
text: When he wished to cross over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him, and wrote to the disciples in Corinth to receive him. On his arrival he mightily helped those who through grace had believed,

title: Acts 18:28
text: for he powerfully refuted the Jews in public argument, proving to them from the Scriptures that Jesus is the Messiah.

title: Acts 19:1
text: Now it happened that while Apollos was in Corinth, Paul, after passing through the hinterland, came to Ephesus, where he found a few disciples.

title: Acts 19:2
text: "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" he asked them. "No" said they, "we did not even hear that there is a Holy Spirit."

title: Acts 19:3
text: "Into what, then, were you baptized?" he asked. And they said, "Into the baptism of John."

title: Acts 19:4
text: "John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance," answered Paul, "telling the people to believe on One who was coming after him, namely, on Jesus."

title: Acts 19:5
text: When they heard this they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus;

title: Acts 19:6
text: and after Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they began to speak with tongues, and to prophesy.

title: Acts 19:7
text: They were in all about twelve men.

title: Acts 19:8
text: Then Paul went into the synagogue, and there continued to preach fearlessly for about three months, reasoning and persuading them about the kingdom of God.

title: Acts 19:9
text: But when some grew hardened and disobedient, and spoke evil of the Way before the crowd, he left them, withdrew the disciples, and continued to hold discussions daily in the lecture-hall of Tyrannus.

title: Acts 19:10
text: This went on for two years, so that all the inhabitants of Asia heard the Lord's message, Jews as well as Greeks.

title: Acts 19:11
text: God also wrought extraordinary miracles by the hand of Paul;

title: Acts 19:12
text: so much so, that handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick; and their diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

title: Acts 19:13
text: But there were also some strolling Jewish exorcists, who took it upon them to invoke the name of Jesus over those who had evil spirits, saying, "I adjure you by that Jesus whom Paul preaches."

title: Acts 19:14
text: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish high priest who used to do this.

title: Acts 19:15
text: But the evil spirit answered, "Jesus I know, and Paul I have heard of, but who are you?"

title: Acts 19:16
text: And the man in whom the evil spirit was sprang on two of them, overpowered them and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of the house naked and wounded.

title: Acts 19:17
text: And this became known to all the people of Ephesus, both Jews and Greeks. Awe fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus began to be held in honor.

title: Acts 19:18
text: Many also of those who became believers used to come to confess and to declare their deeds.

title: Acts 19:19
text: And some of them who had practised magic arts, collected their books, and burned them in the presence of all. And they counted the price of them, and found it to be fifty thousand silver coins.

title: Acts 19:20
text: So mightily the word of the Lord continued to grow and to prevail.

title: Acts 19:21
text: Now after these things were ended, Paul resolved in his spirit to travel through Macedonia and Achaia on his way to Jerusalem. "After I get there," he said, "I must see Rome, too."

title: Acts 19:22
text: So he sent two of his assistants, Timothy and Erastus, into Macedonia, while he himself kept back for a time on his way into Asia.

title: Acts 19:23
text: Now just at this time, there arose no small commotion concerning the Way.

title: Acts 19:24
text: There was a man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Diana, and brought rich profit to his workmen.

title: Acts 19:25
text: He gathered them together with others of like occupation, and said: "Men, you know that by this business we make our money.

title: Acts 19:26
text: "And you see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but almost throughout all of Asia, this fellow Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, by telling them that they are no gods at all who are made with hands.

title: Acts 19:27
text: "So there is danger not only that our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana will be brought into disrepute, and that she herself may even be deposed from her magnificence, she whom all Asia and the world now worships."

title: Acts 19:28
text: After listening to this they were filled with rage, and cried out again and again, saying,

title: Acts 19:29
text: The city was filled with commotion. They rushed like one man into the theater, dragging with them Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians, Paul's companions in travel.

title: Acts 19:30
text: When Paul wanted to go in to the people, the disciples would not let him,

title: Acts 19:31
text: and some of the Asiarchs, too, who were his friends, sent word to him repeatedly, entreating him not to venture into the theater.

title: Acts 19:32
text: Now some were shouting one thing, some another, for the assembly was in an uproar, and the majority had no idea why they were come together.

title: Acts 19:33
text: And they brought Alexander out of the crowd, whom the Jews had pushed forward. And Alexander, motioning with his hand, would have made a defense to the people,

title: Acts 19:34
text: but when they saw that he was a Jew they all, with one voice, for about two hours, shouted,

title: Acts 19:35
text: At length the recorder got them quiet. "Men of Ephesus," he said, "who here does not know that the city of the Ephesians is temple-guardian of the great Diana and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?

title: Acts 19:36
text: "Since these facts cannot be gainsaid, you ought to be calm and do nothing reckless.

title: Acts 19:37
text: "For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of our goddess.

title: Acts 19:38
text: If then Demetrius and his craftsmen have a grievance against any one, the courts are open and there are the proconsuls; let them accuse one another.

title: Acts 19:39
text: But if you desire anything further, it must be settled in the regular assembly.

title: Acts 19:40
text: For indeed we are in danger of being accused in regard to this day's riot, since there is no cause for it, nor shall we be able to give account for this disorderly gathering."

title: Acts 19:41
text: With these words he dismissed the assembly.

title: Acts 20:1
text: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples and, after embracing them, bade them farewell, and started for Macedonia.

title: Acts 20:2
text: And when he had passed through those districts and encouraged the disciples in many addresses, he came into Greece where he spent three months.

title: Acts 20:3
text: Just as he was about to set sail for Syria, the Jews laid a plot against him, and he determined to return through Macedonia.

title: Acts 20:4
text: There accompanied him as far as Asia, Sopater of Berea, the son of Pyrrhus; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy; and the Asians, Tychicus and Trophimus.

title: Acts 20:5
text: Now these had gone on, and were awaiting us at Troas;

title: Acts 20:6
text: but we ourselves set sail from Philippi, after the days of unleavened bread, and joined them five days later at Troas. There we remained for a week.

title: Acts 20:7
text: On the first day of the week we met for the breaking of bread, and Paul, who was going away the next morning, began preaching to them, and prolonged his discourse until midnight.

title: Acts 20:8
text: Now there were many lamps in the upper room where we were assembled,

title: Acts 20:9
text: and a young man named Eutychus was sitting in a window, overborne by deep sleep, while Paul continued to preach at length. Overcome at last by sleep, he fell down from the third story, and was taken up dead.

title: Acts 20:10
text: Then Paul went down, threw himself upon him, and embracing him, said: "Do not lament; his life is still in him."

title: Acts 20:11
text: Then he went upstairs again, broke bread and took some food, and after talking with them a long time, even until daybreak, he left them.

title: Acts 20:12
text: They had taken the lad home alive, and were not a little comforted.

title: Acts 20:13
text: The rest of us going before to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul on board there; for so he had appointed, because he intended to go by land.

title: Acts 20:14
text: And when he met us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

title: Acts 20:15
text: We sailed from thence, and arrived next day off Chios; and the day after we touched at Samos; and the following day we came to Mitylene.

title: Acts 20:16
text: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, so as not to spend time in Asia, for he was hurrying to get to Jerusalem, if it were possible, by the day of Pentecost.

title: Acts 20:17
text: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church to come to him;

title: Acts 20:18
text: and when they arrived, he said to them: "You yourselves know quite well, how I lived among you, from the first day that I set foot in Asia,

title: Acts 20:19
text: "serving the Lord with all lowliness of mind, and with tears, and amid trials that befell me through the plots of the Jews.

title: Acts 20:20
text: "You know that I never shrank from declaring to you anything that was profitable, nor from teaching you publicity and in your homes,

title: Acts 20:21
text: testifying both to Jews and Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Acts 20:22
text: And now I am going to Jerusalem, bound in the Spirit, not knowing what will befall me there,

title: Acts 20:23
text: except that in city after city the Holy Spirit is warning me that bonds and afflictions are awaiting me.

title: Acts 20:24
text: But I hold not my life of any account, as dear unto myself, if only I may run my race, and accomplish the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to attest the gospel of the grace of God.

title: Acts 20:25
text: And now I know that not one of you among whom I went about preaching the kingdom, will ever see my face again.

title: Acts 20:26
text: So I testify to you this day that I am clear from the blood of all men;

title: Acts 20:27
text: I never shrank from telling you the whole counsel of God.

title: Acts 20:28
text: Take heed to yourselves and to all the flock of which the Holy Spirit has appointed you overseers, and be shepherds of the church of God which he has purchased with his own blood.

title: Acts 20:29
text: I know that after my departure fierce wolves will come among you, and they will not spare the flock;

title: Acts 20:30
text: and that from among your own number, men will arise, perverting the truth, to draw away the disciples after them.

title: Acts 20:31
text: So be on guard; and remember that for three years I ceased not to admonish you all, night and day, even with tears.

title: Acts 20:32
text: "And now I commend you to God and to the word of his grace. He is able to build you up, and to give you your inheritance among all those who are consecrated.

title: Acts 20:33
text: "No man's silver or gold of clothing did I ever covet.

title: Acts 20:34
text: "You yourselves know how these hands of mine provided for my needs, and those of my companions.

title: Acts 20:35
text: "In all things I have set you an example, how that so toiling, you ought to help the weak and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he himself said, "It is more blessed to give than to receive."

title: Acts 20:36
text: When he had so said, Paul kneeled down, and prayed with them.

title: Acts 20:37
text: And they all began, with loud lamentations, to throw their arms about his neck, and to kiss him lovingly, again and again,

title: Acts 20:38
text: sorrowing most of all for the words that he had spoken, that after that day they should look upon his face no more. And they began to escort him to the ship.

title: Acts 21:1
text: When at least we had torn ourselves away, and had set sail, we ran a straight course to Cos, and next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

title: Acts 21:2
text: And when we had found a ship bound for Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

title: Acts 21:3
text: After sighting Cyprus and leaving it on the left hand, we sailed for Syria, and put in at Tyre; for there the ship was to unload her cargo.

title: Acts 21:4
text: We looked up the local disciples and remained there seven days; and these disciples kept telling Paul, through the Spirit, that he should not set foot in Jerusalem.

title: Acts 21:5
