text: by which also you are saved, if you are holding fast the message which I preached to you; unless indeed you have believed in vain.

title: I Corinthians 15:3
text: For the very first thing I taught you was that I had myself been taught, that Christ died for our sins according to the Scripture,

title: I Corinthians 15:4
text: that he was buried, and that he was raised the third day, according to the Scriptures,

title: I Corinthians 15:5
text: and was seen by Cephas, and then by the Twelve.

title: I Corinthians 15:6
text: Afterward he was seen at one time by more than five hundred brethren, most of whom are still alive, but some are fallen asleep.

title: I Corinthians 15:7
text: Then he was seen by James, then by all the apostles,

title: I Corinthians 15:8
text: and last of all, as by one born out of due time, he was seen by me also.

title: I Corinthians 15:9
text: For I am the least of the apostles, I who am not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

title: I Corinthians 15:10
text: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and that grace of his, bestowed upon me, did not prove ineffectual. I labored more abundantly than all the rest, yet not I, but by the grace of God that is with me.

title: I Corinthians 15:11
text: But whether it is I or they, thus do I preach, and thus you came to believe.

title: I Corinthians 15:12
text: If then, we are preaching Christ, that he rose from the dead, how are some of you saying that there is no resurrection from the dead?

title: I Corinthians 15:13
text: But if there is no resurrection from the dead, then not even Christ has been raised;

title: I Corinthians 15:14
text: and if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is vain, and vain also is your faith.

title: I Corinthians 15:15
text: More than that, we are detected in bearing false witness against God; because we testified of God that he raised Christ from the dead, whom he did not raise, if indeed the dead rise not.

title: I Corinthians 15:16
text: For if the dead rise not, neither has Christ arisen;

title: I Corinthians 15:17
text: and if Christ be not risen, your faith is vain, you are still in your sins.

title: I Corinthians 15:18
text: More than that, those who are sleeping in Christ have perished.

title: I Corinthians 15:19
text: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all mankind most pitiable.

title: I Corinthians 15:20
text: But now, now, Christ is risen from the dead, the first-fruit of those who have fallen asleep.

title: I Corinthians 15:21
text: For since by man came to death, by man came also the resurrection from the dead.

title: I Corinthians 15:22
text: For just as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

title: I Corinthians 15:23
text: But each in his own order; Christ the first-fruits, then those who belong to Christ at his appearing.

title: I Corinthians 15:24
text: And then the end, when he shall hand over his kingdom to God his Father, after he has abolished all rule and authority and power.

title: I Corinthians 15:25
text: For he must rule until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

title: I Corinthians 15:26
text: The last enemy that will be destroyed is Death.

title: I Corinthians 15:27
text: For He hast put all things under his feet, but in that quotation All things are put under him, it is evident that God is excepted, who put all things under Him.

title: I Corinthians 15:28
text: For when everything is subjected to him, then the Son himself shall subject himself to Him who made them subject, that God may be all in all.

title: I Corinthians 15:29
text: Else what shall they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are really not raised, why are they baptized for them?

title: I Corinthians 15:30
text: Yes, and why am I myself exposed to danger every hour?

title: I Corinthians 15:31
text: Every day I am facing death, my brothers, I affirm it by that pride in you which I have through Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: I Corinthians 15:32
text: If after the manner of men I have fought with wild beasts at Ephesus, what good does it do me? If the dead do not rise, Let us eat and drink, For we shall be dead tomorrow.

title: I Corinthians 15:33
text: Do not deceive yourselves: Evil companions ruin good morals.

title: I Corinthians 15:34
text: Wake up, do justly, cease from sin; for I say to your shame that some of you have no acquaintance with God.

title: I Corinthians 15:35
text: But some one will ask: "How are the dead raised? and with what body are they coming?"

title: I Corinthians 15:36
text: Foolish man! The seed you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

title: I Corinthians 15:37
text: And when you sow the seed you are not sowing the body that it will become, but bare grain, of wheat perhaps, or some other grain.

title: I Corinthians 15:38
text: But God gives it what body he pleases, and to each kind of seed its own body.

title: I Corinthians 15:39
text: All flesh is not the same flesh; there is human flesh, another of fishes of animals, another of birds, another of fishes.

title: I Corinthians 15:40
text: There are both celestial bodies and bodies terrestrial; but the splendor of the celestial is one thing, and the splendor of the terrestrial is another.

title: I Corinthians 15:41
text: There is one glory of the sun, another of the moon, and another of the stars; for star differs from star in glory.

title: I Corinthians 15:42
text: So it is in the resurrection of the dead: It is sown in corruption, It is raised in incorruption;

title: I Corinthians 15:43
text: Sown in weakness, It is raised in power;

title: I Corinthians 15:44
text: The body sown is animal The body is raised is spiritual. If there is an animal body, there is also a spiritual body.

title: I Corinthians 15:45
text: Thus it is written: The first man, Adam, became a living being, the last Adam, a life-giving Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 15:46
text: Now it is not the spiritual which is first, but the animal, and then the spiritual.

title: I Corinthians 15:47
text: The first man is of the earth, earthly; the second Man is of heaven.

title: I Corinthians 15:48
text: Like him who was of earth, are the earthy; and like Him who is of heaven, are the heavenly;

title: I Corinthians 15:49
text: As we have borne the likeness of him who was of earth, so also let us bear the likeness of Him who is of heaven.

title: I Corinthians 15:50
text: I tell you this, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; nor can corruption inherit incorruption.

title: I Corinthians 15:51
text: Lo, I tell you a secret truth: we shall not all be sleeping, but we shall be changed,

title: I Corinthians 15:52
text: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, when the last trumpet sounds. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised, incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

title: I Corinthians 15:53
text: For this corruptible must be clothed with incorruption, and this mortal must be clothed with immortality.

title: I Corinthians 15:54
text: And when this mortal has been clothed with immortality, then will the words of Scripture come to pass, Death has been swallowed up in victory.

title: I Corinthians 15:55
text: Where, Death, is thy victory? Where, Death, is thy sting?

title: I Corinthians 15:56
text: Now the sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the Law.

title: I Corinthians 15:57
text: But thanks be to God, who has given us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 15:58
text: So, my brothers beloved, stand firm, immovable, always abounding in work for the Lord, because you know that your toil is not fruitless in the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 16:1
text: Now concerning the offering for the saints, you also are to do as I directed the church of Galatia.

title: I Corinthians 16:2
text: On the first day of each week let each of you put aside something, keeping it in store as he may prosper, so that when I come there may be no collections going on.

title: I Corinthians 16:3
text: On my arrival I will send those whom you may accredit by letter to carry your bounty to Jerusalem.

title: I Corinthians 16:4
text: And if it is worth while for me to go too, they will accompany me.

title: I Corinthians 16:5
text: Now I shall come to you after I have gone through Macedonia.

title: I Corinthians 16:6
text: I shall remain some time with you; possibly spending the winter, in order that you may help me forward in whatever journey I take.

title: I Corinthians 16:7
text: For I do not wish at this present time to see you merely in passing; but if the Lord permits, I hope to remain some time with you.

title: I Corinthians 16:8
text: I am staying for the present in Ephesus, until Pentecost;

title: I Corinthians 16:9
text: for a door has opened to me, great and effectual, and the opponents are many.

title: I Corinthians 16:10
text: If Timothy come, see to it that he is among you without trepidation; for he is doing the Lord's work, as I am, so let no one disparage him.

title: I Corinthians 16:11
text: Whenever he comes to me, send him on his way in peace, for I am expecting him with the other brothers.

title: I Corinthians 16:12
text: As for our Apollos, I have many times urged him to go to you with the others, but he was always unwilling to go to you at this time. He will come, however, whenever he has a good opportunity.

title: I Corinthians 16:13
text: Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, be manly, be strong.

title: I Corinthians 16:14
text: Let all that you do be done in love.

title: I Corinthians 16:15
text: I beg you this, my brothers--you know the household of Stephanus, that they were the first-fruits of Achaia, and that they devoted themselves to the service of the saints--

title: I Corinthians 16:16
text: so I want you also to show deference to such, and to every fellow worker, and laborer.

title: I Corinthians 16:17
text: I am glad that Stephanus and Fortunatus and Achaicus have arrived, for they have made up for your absence.

title: I Corinthians 16:18
text: They refresh my spirit as they do yours. So cultivate the acquaintance of such men.

title: I Corinthians 16:19
text: The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla (Prisca), with the church that meets in their house, greet you heartily in the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 16:20
text: All the brothers send greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

title: I Corinthians 16:21
text: The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand.

title: I Corinthians 16:22
text: If any one does not love the Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord is coming.

title: I Corinthians 16:23
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

title: I Corinthians 16:24
text: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus.

title: II Corinthians 1:1
text: To the Church of God which is in Corinth, and to all the saints throughout Greece: from Paul, by God's will an apostle of Christ, and from brother Timothy:

title: II Corinthians 1:2
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father in the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Corinthians 1:3
text: Thanks be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of tender mercies and the God of all comfort,

title: II Corinthians 1:4
text: who ever comforts me in all my troubles, so that I may be continually able to comfort those who are in any trouble by the comfort with which God is ever comforting me.

title: II Corinthians 1:5
text: For just as I have more than my share in the sufferings of the Christ, so also through the Christ I have more than my share of comfort.

title: II Corinthians 1:6
text: If I am afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; and if I am receiving comfort, it is for your comfort--a comfort produced within you by your patient fortitude, under the same sufferings which I also am enduring.

title: II Corinthians 1:7
text: My hope for you is firm; for I know that as you are comrades in my sufferings, so also are you comrades in my comfort.

title: II Corinthians 1:8
text: Now, brothers, I want you to know about the troubles which befell me in Asia; how I was burdened altogether beyond my strength, so that I renounced all hope even of life itself.

title: II Corinthians 1:9
text: Indeed, I had in myself, and still have, the sentence of death, in order that I might not rely on myself, but on God who raises the dead to life.

title: II Corinthians 1:10
text: He delivered me from such a death, and will deliver me. On him I have set my hopes that he will continue to deliver me,

title: II Corinthians 1:11
text: while all of you also are helping me by your prayers; so that from many lips thanksgiving may rise on my behalf for the blessings vouchsafed to me through the intercessions of many.

title: II Corinthians 1:12
text: For this is my proud boast, the testimony of my conscience, that it was in holiness and with pure motives before God, not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God, that I have conducted myself in the world, and above all in my relations with you.

title: II Corinthians 1:13
text: For I am writing to you nothing different from what you read aloud and very well recognize, and I hope will continue to recognize to the very end,

title: II Corinthians 1:14
text: as some indeed did recognize in part at last, that I am your cause of boasting, just as you will be mine on the Day of Jesus our Lord.

title: II Corinthians 1:15
text: And in this confidence I intended to visit you, before going elsewhere, that you might have a pleasure twice over.

title: II Corinthians 1:16
text: I intended to go by you into Macedonia, and to come again to you from Macedonia, and by you to be sent forward on my way to Judea.

title: II Corinthians 1:17
text: In purposing this did I display "caprice"? Or what I purpose do I purpose in a worldly way , so that it may mean either "Yes, yes," or "No, no"?

title: II Corinthians 1:18
text: As God is faithful, my message to you is not now "Yes," now "No."

title: II Corinthians 1:19
text: For Jesus Christ, Son of God, who was proclaimed among you by us, that is, by Silvanus and Timothy and me, was not wavering between "Yes" and "No," but in him is the everlasting "Yes."

title: II Corinthians 1:20
text: For however many are the promises of God, in him they are "Yes." Therefore also through him let the Amen be said by our voices to the glory of God.

title: II Corinthians 1:21
text: And he who has established me with you in the Anointed One, and has anointed me, is God.

title: II Corinthians 1:22
text: He has also set his seal upon me, and given me the pledge of his Spirit in my heart.

title: II Corinthians 1:23
text: But for my part I call God to witness, as my soul shall answer for it, that it was to spare you that I came not to Corinth

title: II Corinthians 1:24
text: (not that I am attempting to lord it over your faith, but rather to work with you for your happiness); for your faith is stedfast.

title: II Corinthians 2:1
text: I decided that I would not visit you again in grief;

title: II Corinthians 2:2
text: for if I cause you grief, who is there to cause me joy except those whom I have grieved?

title: II Corinthians 2:3
text: And for this very reason I wrote you, that I might not come only to be grieved by those who ought to give me joy; and because I trusted in you all, that my joy is the joy of all of you.

title: II Corinthians 2:4
text: For I wrote to you out of much affliction and anguish of heart, through many tears; not to pain you, but to convince you of my love, my abundant love for you.

title: II Corinthians 2:5
text: As to him who has been, and now is, causing pain, it is not I whom he has pained, but all of you--at least some of you (not to overstate the case).

title: II Corinthians 2:6
text: Sufficient for the offender is the punishment imposed by the majority;

title: II Corinthians 2:7
text: so that now you ought rather to forgive and comfort him, lest he should be overwhelmed by the excess of his grief.

title: II Corinthians 2:8
text: So I beg you to reinstate him in your love.

title: II Corinthians 2:9
text: For this very purpose also I wrote you (before), that I might test you, to see if you were obedient in every respect.

title: II Corinthians 2:10
text: If you forgive the man, I forgive him, too; for whatever I have forgiven has been forgiven in the presence of Christ,

title: II Corinthians 2:11
text: for your sakes, that I may not be overreached by Satan, for I am not ignorant of his devices.

title: II Corinthians 2:12
text: Now when I came to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ, although a door was opened to me in the Lord,

title: II Corinthians 2:13
text: I could get no peace of mind because I failed to find Titus, my brother. So I bade them good-bye and started off for Macedonia.

title: II Corinthians 2:14
text: But thanks be to God, who in every place is leading me in the train of Christ's triumph, and is making manifest through me the knowledge of him, an odor of incense everywhere.

title: II Corinthians 2:15
text: I am Christ's fragrance upwafted unto God, among those who are being saved and those who are perishing;

title: II Corinthians 2:16
text: to these latter an odor of death to death, to the former, of life to life. For such service as this, who is sufficient?

title: II Corinthians 2:17
text: I am; for I am not like most, trafficking in the word of God, but rather from a sincere heart, like a man of God, I speak in Christ, in the very presence of God.

title: II Corinthians 3:1
text: Am I beginning again to "recommend" myself? Or do I need, as some do, letters of commendation either to you or from you?

title: II Corinthians 3:2
text: You are my letter, written on my heart, known and read by all men.

title: II Corinthians 3:3
text: Since all can see that you are a letter of Christ transcribed by men, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone, but on human hearts as tablets.

title: II Corinthians 3:4
text: Such confidence I have through Christ before God.

title: II Corinthians 3:5
text: Not that I am sufficient in myself to reach any conclusion in my own wisdom; but my sufficiency is from God.

title: II Corinthians 3:6
text: It is he who has also made me sufficient as a minister of a new covenant; not of a letter but of a spirit; for the letter kills, but the spirit makes alive.

title: II Corinthians 3:7
text: If, however, the administration of death, written with letters and engraved on stones, began in glory, so that the children of Israel could not gaze steadily on the face of Moses, because of the glory of his face--a glory even then fading--

title: II Corinthians 3:8
text: how much more shall the ministry of the Spirit abide in glory?

title: II Corinthians 3:9
text: For if the ministry of condemnation had glory, far more is the ministry of righteousness radiant in glory.

title: II Corinthians 3:10
text: Indeed that which once was glorious has lost its glory, because of the glory which surpasses it.

title: II Corinthians 3:11
text: For if that which was fading came in glory, far more will that which ever abides be glorious.

title: II Corinthians 3:12
text: Therefore, cherishing such a hope, I use great freedom of speech.

title: II Corinthians 3:13
text: I do not do as Moses did, who used to cover his face with a veil to keep the children of Israel from beholding the passing of a fading glory.

title: II Corinthians 3:14
text: Nay, their minds were made dull; for to this very day, at the public reading of the Old Testament, the same veil rests thereon, because it is not revealed to them that in Christ the veil is taken away.

title: II Corinthians 3:15
text: Yes, to this very day, whenever Moses is read, a veil lies on their hearts;

title: II Corinthians 3:16
text: but when their heart turns to our Lord the veil is stripped away.

title: II Corinthians 3:17
text: (The Lord means the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord abides there is freedom.)

title: II Corinthians 3:18
text: And we all, with unveiled faces, reflecting like a mirror the glory of the Lord, are ourselves continually being transformed into the same likeness, from glory to glory, as by the Lord, the Spirit.

title: II Corinthians 4:1
text: So then, as I have this ministry because of God's mercy to me, I do not lose heart.

title: II Corinthians 4:2
text: I have renounced the hidden things of shame, not spending my life in craftiness, nor adulterating the word of God; but setting forth the truth openly, I strive to commend myself to every man's conscience as in the sight of God.

title: II Corinthians 4:3
text: But even if my gospel, too, is "veiled," it is among those who are on the way to perish that it is "veiled."

title: II Corinthians 4:4
text: Among them the god of this age has blinded the understanding of the unbelieving so that the sunshine of the gospel of God, should not dawn upon them.

title: II Corinthians 4:5
text: It is not myself that I proclaim, but Christ Jesus as Master, and myself that I proclaim, and myself your slave for Jesus' sake.

title: II Corinthians 4:6
text: For God who said, "Out of darkness light shall shine," is he who has shone in my heart, that the sunrise of the knowledge of God may shine forth in the face of Christ.

title: II Corinthians 4:7
text: But I hold this treasure in an earthen vessel, in order that the surpassing greatness of the power may be from God, and not from myself.

title: II Corinthians 4:8
text: On every side I am hard pressed, yet not hemmed in; perplexed, but not in despair;

title: II Corinthians 4:9
text: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.

title: II Corinthians 4:10
text: Wherever I go, I am always carrying about in my body the dying of Jesus, in order that the life also of Jesus may be made manifest in this body of mine.

title: II Corinthians 4:11
text: For, alive though I am, I am always given over to death for the sake of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may shine forth in my dying flesh.

title: II Corinthians 4:12
text: So while death is working in me, life is working in you.

title: II Corinthians 4:13
text: But having the same spirit of faith of which it is written, I believed, and therefore have spoken, I also believe and so I speak.

title: II Corinthians 4:14
text: For I know that He who raised from the dead the Lord Jesus, will raise me also with Jesus, and set me at your side in his presence.

title: II Corinthians 4:15
text: For everything is for your sakes, so that more abundant grace, because of the thanksgiving of many voices, might overflow to the glory of God.

title: II Corinthians 4:16
text: For this reason, as I have said, I do not lose courage, but even though my outward man is wasting away, my inward man is being renewed, day by day.

title: II Corinthians 4:17
text: For my light affliction, which is but for a moment, is working out for me a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory,

title: II Corinthians 4:18
text: while I am gazing not at things seen, but at things unseen; for things seen are temporal, but things unseen are eternal.

title: II Corinthians 5:1
text: For I know, if this earthly tent of mine were struck, I have a mansion built by God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

title: II Corinthians 5:2
text: For in this tent I am groaning, earnestly longing to be under the cover of my heavenly habitation; if so be that being so covered,

title: II Corinthians 5:3
text: I shall not be found naked.

title: II Corinthians 5:4
text: For in this tent of mine I am groaning in deep trouble; not that I wish to be unclothed, but to be clothed upon, that what is mortal may be swallowed up in life.

title: II Corinthians 5:5
text: And He who has wrought me out for this very end is God, who has given me his Spirit as pledge.

title: II Corinthians 5:6
text: Therefore I am always of good courage, because I well know that while I am at home in the body, I am in banishment from the Lord,

title: II Corinthians 5:7
text: for I am walking by faith, not by sight.

title: II Corinthians 5:8
text: So I have good courage, and am well pleased rather, to be in banishment from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 5:9
text: And for this reason I also make it home with the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 5:10
text: For we must all be made manifest, in our true characters, before the Judgment-seat of Christ; so that each one may receive according to that which he has done in his body, whether good or evil.

title: II Corinthians 5:11
text: So, because I know the fear of God, I "persuade men." What I am is manifest to God, and I hope manifest also to your conscience.

title: II Corinthians 5:12
text: I am not "commending myself to you again," but I am giving you an occasion of boasting on my behalf, so that you may have an answer ready for those who boast in externals, and not in the heart.

title: II Corinthians 5:13
text: For if I was "beside myself," it was to God; of if I am now "of sound mind," it is for you.

title: II Corinthians 5:14
text: For the love of Christ overmasters me; because I thus judge that if One has died for all, then all have died;

title: II Corinthians 5:15
text: and that he died for all in order that the living may live no longer for themselves, but for Him who died and rose again for them.

title: II Corinthians 5:16
text: Therefore henceforth I know no one simply as a man--even if I have known Christ as a man, yet now I do so no longer.

title: II Corinthians 5:17
text: So there is a new creation when any man is in Christ. The old life has passed away, behold, the new is come.

title: II Corinthians 5:18
text: And all this is from God, who through Christ reconciled me to himself, and gave me the ministry of reconciliation;

title: II Corinthians 5:19
text: how that God was in Christ reconciling a world to himself, not reckoning to men their trespasses; and that to me he has entrusted the message of that reconciliation.

title: II Corinthians 5:20
text: On Christ's behalf, then, I come as ambassador. It is as though God was entreating you, through me, on Christ's behalf I beg you to be reconciled to God.

title: II Corinthians 5:21
text: Him who knew no sin, in our behalf he has made to be sin; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

title: II Corinthians 6:1
text: As a worker with him I beseech you not to receive the grace of God in vain.

title: II Corinthians 6:2
text: For he said: In an acceptable time have I heard thee, And in the day of salvation have I succored thee. Behold, now is the acceptable time! behold, now is the day of salvation!

title: II Corinthians 6:3
text: I am giving no one a cause of stumbling in order that my ministry may not be discredited;

title: II Corinthians 6:4
text: but in every way I am striving to commend myself as God's minister by stedfast endurance, by afflictions, by troubles, by distresses,

title: II Corinthians 6:5
text: by floggings, by imprisonment; in riots, in labors, in sleepless watching, in hunger and thirst;

title: II Corinthians 6:6
text: with purity, understanding, patience, and kindness; by the Holy Spirit, by love sincere,

title: II Corinthians 6:7
text: by a true teaching and an energy divine; by the weapons of righteousness, for attack or for defense,

title: II Corinthians 6:8
text: amid honor or dishonor, amid evil report and good report; as a deceiver and yet true;

title: II Corinthians 6:9
text: as unknown and yet well known; as at death's door, yet, strange to tell, I live on; as chastened, but not killed;

title: II Corinthians 6:10
text: as grieved, but always glad; as poor, but making many rich; as having nothing, yet possessing everything.

title: II Corinthians 6:11
text: O Corinthians, I am unsealing my lips to you; my heart is wide open to you.

title: II Corinthians 6:12
text: There is no narrowness in my love; but the narrowness is in your own.

title: II Corinthians 6:13
text: I pray you, therefore, in fair exchange (I speak as to my children), let your hearts also be wide open to me.

title: II Corinthians 6:14
text: [Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers; for what fellowship has righteousness with lawlessness? what communion has light with darkness?

title: II Corinthians 6:15
text: What concord has Christ with Belial? What portion has a believer with an unbeliever?

title: II Corinthians 6:16
text: And what compact has God's temple with idols? For we are a temple of the living God, as he has said: I will dwell among them, and walk about among them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.

title: II Corinthians 6:17
text: Therefore, Come out from among them and separate yourselves, saith the Lord, touch not what is unclean;

title: II Corinthians 6:18
text: then I will receive you and will be to you a Father, and you shall be to me sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

title: II Corinthians 7:1
text: As these promises are ours, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from every defilement of body and of spirit, and perfect our holiness in the fear of God.]

title: II Corinthians 7:2
text: Make room for me in your hearts! I have wronged no man, I have ruined no man, I have defrauded no man.

title: II Corinthians 7:3
text: I am not saying this to blame you, for as I have already said, I hold you in my heart to live together and to die together.

title: II Corinthians 7:4
text: Great is my faith in you; great is my cheerful assurance in you. I am filled with comfort; in spite of all my troubles, my heart is overflowing with joy.

title: II Corinthians 7:5
text: For even after I reached Macedonia, my flesh had no rest, but I was troubled on every hand. Without were fights; within were, fears.

title: II Corinthians 7:6
text: But the God who comforts the down-hearted comforted me by the coming of Titus,

title: II Corinthians 7:7
text: and not alone by his coming, but also by the comfort you had been to him. For he told me of your eager longing, of your penitence, and of your zeal on my behalf, so that I was happier still.

title: II Corinthians 7:8
text: Even if I caused you pain by my letter, I do not regret; though I did regret it when I saw that my letter had caused you pain, even for a time.

title: II Corinthians 7:9
text: But now I am glad; not because you were pained; but because your pain led you to repentance.

title: II Corinthians 7:10
text: For your pain came from God, and so you took no harm from me. For the pain which is from God works repentance leading to salvation, a repentance never to be regretted. But the world's pain works death.

title: II Corinthians 7:11
text: Note the results of this pain which God permitted; what earnestness it has called forth in you, what explanations, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what fervor, what punishment of wrong. In every way you have proved yourselves innocent in the matter.

title: II Corinthians 7:12
text: So then, even if I did write to you, it was not for the sake of the wrong-doer, or of him who had been wronged, but to make clear to yourselves in the sight of God your earnest care for me.

title: II Corinthians 7:13
text: This is what comforts me. In addition to this comfort of mine, I have been made still happier by the happiness of Titus; because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

title: II Corinthians 7:14
text: Although I have been boasting a little to him about you, I have not been put to shame. But as in every matter I have spoken the truth to you, so also my boast to Titus has been proved to be the truth.

title: II Corinthians 7:15
text: And his tender affection is all the greater toward you, when he calls to mind the obedience of you all, and the fear and trembling with which you received him.

title: II Corinthians 7:16
text: I rejoice that I have complete confidence in you.

title: II Corinthians 8:1
text: Now, brothers, I wish to tell you about the grace of God which has been manifest in the churches of Macedonia.

title: II Corinthians 8:2
text: For although in heavy trial of affliction, their overbrimming happiness, even in spite of their deep poverty, abounded to the opulence of their unselfishness.

title: II Corinthians 8:3
text: For I can testify that according to their ability, and even beyond their ability, of their own free will, too, they have given help.

title: II Corinthians 8:4
text: With earnest entreaty they craved of me the privilege of a share in ministering to the saints [in Jerusalem].

title: II Corinthians 8:5
text: And this not as I had expected, but in accordance with the will of God, they first gave themselves to God and to me.

title: II Corinthians 8:6
text: With the result that I have been begging Titus that, as he had been the one to begin the work with you, so he should complete among you this grace also.

title: II Corinthians 8:7
text: Now then, as you excel in everything, in faith and utterance and knowledge and all zeal and in your love to me, see to it that you excel in this grace also.

title: II Corinthians 8:8
text: I do not say this by way of command, but by the zeal of others I am trying to prove the reality of your love.

title: II Corinthians 8:9
text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, how though he was rich, for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

title: II Corinthians 8:10
text: And I will give you my opinion in this matter; for this offering is fitting in your case, considering that you made a beginning before others, not only in the willingness to do something but also in actually doing something a year ago.

title: II Corinthians 8:11
text: So now complete the doing of it also, in order that just as there was the readiness to will, so there may be the accomplishment according to your means.

title: II Corinthians 8:12
text: For if there be first willing mind, the gift is accepted according to what a man has, and not according to what he has not.

title: II Corinthians 8:13
text: Nor are other people to be relieved, and you to be distressed;

title: II Corinthians 8:14
text: but burdens are to be equalized. Now your abundance at this present time present time is a supply for their want, in supply for your want; and so burdens be equalized,

title: II Corinthians 8:15
text: even as it is written, He who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little did not lack.

title: II Corinthians 8:16
text: But thanks be to God who has inspired in the heart of Titus the same zeal on your behalf that I have.

title: II Corinthians 8:17
text: For he not only consented to my request, but being thoroughly in earnest, comes to you of his own accord.

title: II Corinthians 8:18
text: And I am sending with him that brother whose fame in the service of the gospel is spread through all the churches.

title: II Corinthians 8:19
text: More than that, he is the one chosen by the churches to accompany me on my journey, in administering this gift of yours for the Lord's glory. And this has my full consent,

title: II Corinthians 8:20
text: because I am on my guard in this, that no one should blame me, in respect to this bounty which I am administering.

title: II Corinthians 8:21
text: For I aim at being above reproach, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

title: II Corinthians 8:22
text: With them I am sending our brother of whose zeal I have often had proof in many ways, and who is now zealous because of his great confidence in you.

title: II Corinthians 8:23
text: As for Titus, remember that he is a partner of mine, and is also my associate in labors for you. As for the other brothers, remember that they are delegates from the churches, men in whom Christ is glorified.

title: II Corinthians 8:24
text: So show to the churches an evidence of your love, and a justification to these brothers of my boasting about you.

title: II Corinthians 9:1
text: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write you in regard to the ministration to the saints [at Jerusalem],

title: II Corinthians 9:2
text: for I know how ready you are, and am always boasting about you to the Macedonians, telling them that Greece has been ready for a year past; and your zeal has been a spur to the majority of them.

title: II Corinthians 9:3
text: Nevertheless I am sending the brothers in order that my boast about you may not prove vain in this instance; so that, as I kept saying, you may be prepared.

title: II Corinthians 9:4
text: For if any Macedonians come with me and find you not ready, shame would come upon me (not to speak of you) in respect to this confidence.

title: II Corinthians 9:5
text: So I have thought that I must ask these brothers to visit you beforehand, and get your promised contribution ready in advance. I want it to be given of your bounty, not extorted from your covetousness.

title: II Corinthians 9:6
text: Mark this; he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly; and he who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

title: II Corinthians 9:7
text: But let each give according to the purpose of his heart; not grudgingly of under compulsion. It is a cheerful giver that God loves.

title: II Corinthians 9:8
text: And God is able to give you an overflowing measure of every grace, so that all your wants of every kind may be supplied at all times, and you may give of your abundance to every good work;

title: II Corinthians 9:9
text: As it is written: He scattered broadcast, he gave to the poor; His almsgiving continues forever.

title: II Corinthians 9:10
text: He who ever supplies seed to the sower, and bread for the food of man, will supply and make plentous your seed, and increase the harvest springing up from your almsgiving.

title: II Corinthians 9:11
text: You yourselves will be enriched with all good things, that you may give ungrudgingly; and your gifts, of which I am the agent, will make men give thanks to God.

title: II Corinthians 9:12
text: Because the ministry of this contribution not only supplies the needs of the saints, but also overflows in many a thanksgiving to God.

title: II Corinthians 9:13
text: For this ministration proves you. On account of it men glorify God for your faithfulness to your professions of the gospel of Christ, and for the liberality of your gifts to them and to all.

title: II Corinthians 9:14
text: Moreover, in their prayers for you they will be longing after you, because of the exceeding grace of God that is resting upon you.

title: II Corinthians 9:15
text: THANKS BE TO GOD FOR HIS UNSPEAKABLE GIFT!

title: II Corinthians 10:1
text: Now I Paul, myself, appeal to you by the humble-heartedness and selflessness of Christ--Paul who "in your presence is humble, but bold enough when he is absent"--

title: II Corinthians 10:2
text: I beseech you, and I say, do not make me show my boldness, when I come in the boldness with which I think I shall show my courage against some who think that I am walking on the low level of the flesh.

title: II Corinthians 10:3
text: Though I do walk on the low level of the flesh, I do not make war as the flesh does;

title: II Corinthians 10:4
text: for the weapons of my warfare are not weapons of the flesh, but mighty for God, in pulling down all fortresses.

title: II Corinthians 10:5
text: For I pull down imaginations and every crag that lifts itself against the knowledge of God. And I carry every thought away into captivity and subjection to Christ;

title: II Corinthians 10:6
text: and I am fully prepared to punish every act of disobedience, when once your submission has been put beyond question.

title: II Corinthians 10:7
text: Look these facts in the face. If any man is fully persuaded as regards himself that he belongs to Christ, let him consider again with himself, that just as he is Christ's, so also am I.

title: II Corinthians 10:8
text: If, however, I were to boast more loudly concerning the authority which the Lord gave me (not to cast you down, but to build you up), I should have no cause for shame.

title: II Corinthians 10:9
text: Let it not seem as if I were overawing you with my letters.

title: II Corinthians 10:10
text: "His letters indeed," says one, "are mighty and forcible, but his personality is weak, and his speech contemptible."

title: II Corinthians 10:11
text: Let such a man assure himself that my actions, when I am present, will be just like my words in my letters when I am absent.

title: II Corinthians 10:12
text: I have not indeed the audacity to class myself among, or compare myself with, certain of the self-commenders; yet they are not wise in measuring themselves by one another and in comparing themselves with one another.

title: II Corinthians 10:13
text: I, however, will not indulge in undue boasting, but will confine it within the limits of the sphere to which God has assigned me--a sphere which reaches even to you.

title: II Corinthians 10:14
text: For I am not overstepping the limits of my authority, as though I reached you not; since I have already come even as far as Corinth to proclaim the gospel of Christ.

title: II Corinthians 10:15
text: I am not "boasting beyond measure in the labors of others," but it is my hope that, as your faith goes on increasing among yourselves, by the enlargement of my appointed limits,

title: II Corinthians 10:16
text: I may carry the gospel to countries beyond you; and not be boasting of work made ready to my hand within another man's limit.

title: II Corinthians 10:17
text: Meanwhile. Let him who boasts, boast in the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 10:18
text: For a man is proved worthy, not by his self-commendation, but when he is commended by the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 11:1
text: Would that you could put up with a little "folly" from me! Nay, do bear with me.

title: II Corinthians 11:2
text: I have a divine jealousy on your behalf; for I betrothed you to one only husband, even to Christ, that I might present you to him, a chaste virgin.

title: II Corinthians 11:3
text: But I fear lest, just as the serpent beguiled Eve in his craftiness, so your minds should be seduced from your single-mindedness and purity toward Christ.

title: II Corinthians 11:4
text: If indeed some one is coming to preach another Jesus, whom I did not preach, or you are receiving a Spirit other than you once received, or another gospel which you did not accept before, you would do well to bear with me.

title: II Corinthians 11:5
text: For I reckon that I am in no respect behind your superapostolic apostles.

title: II Corinthians 11:6
text: Yes, though I be unskilled in speech, at least I am not in knowledge; indeed I made this perfectly plain to you in all things and among all men.

title: II Corinthians 11:7
text: Is it a sin, forsooth, that I humbled myself that you might be exalted, in preaching the gospel to you free of cost?

title: II Corinthians 11:8
text: Other churches I spoiled, and took their wages to do you service.

title: II Corinthians 11:9
text: Even when I lacked the actual necessities of life while I was with you, I was a burden to no one; for whatever I lacked, the brothers from Macedonia supplied, when they came. So I kept myself from being a burden to you in any way, and will continue to do so.

title: II Corinthians 11:10
text: As the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine shall not be stopped within the boundaries of Greece!

title: II Corinthians 11:11
text: And why? Because I love you not? God knows I do.

title: II Corinthians 11:12
text: I am doing and will continue to do this in order to cut away the ground from under those who wish some cause for slander; and that the ground of their boasting may appear as does mine.

title: II Corinthians 11:13
text: For such fellows are sham apostles of Christ.

title: II Corinthians 11:14
text: No wonder! for Satan himself disguises himself as an angel of light.

title: II Corinthians 11:15
text: It is no great marvel, then, if his ministers also disguise themselves as ministers of righteousness. Their end will be according to their works.

title: II Corinthians 11:16
text: I say again, let no one think me a fool. Or, if you must, at least bear with me as a fool, that I, too, may do a little boasting.

title: II Corinthians 11:17
text: What I am about to say I am not speaking by the Lord's command, but as it were in pure folly, in this boldness of boasting.

title: II Corinthians 11:18
text: Since so many are making worldly boasts, I shall boast, too!

title: II Corinthians 11:19
text: Although you are wise, you put up with fools willingly enough!

title: II Corinthians 11:20
text: You put up with it, though they make slaves of you, live on you, seize your property, lord it over you, even strike you in the face, in the way of degradation!

title: II Corinthians 11:21
text: I say that I was weak, and yet for whatever reason any one is bold (I speak in mere folly) I too am bold.

title: II Corinthians 11:22
text: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they descendants of Israel? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.

title: II Corinthians 11:23
text: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as though I were beside myself), such, far, more, am I; in labors more abundant, in imprisonments also more abundant, in floggings beyond measure, in deaths often.

title: II Corinthians 11:24
text: Five times at the hands of the Jews, I have received one short of forty lashes.

title: II Corinthians 11:25
text: Three times I have been scourged by the Romans; once I have been stoned; three times have I been shipwrecked; a night and a day have I been adrift in the open sea.

title: II Corinthians 11:26
text: My journeys have been many; in perils of rivers, in perils of bandits; in perils from my countrymen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness; in perils on the sea, in perils among false brothers;

title: II Corinthians 11:27
text: in toil and weariness, often in sleepless watching, in hunger and thirst, often without anything to eat; in cold and in nakedness.

title: II Corinthians 11:28
text: Not to mention other things, there is the crowding pressure of each day upon me, the care of all the churches.

title: II Corinthians 11:29
text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, but I burn with indignation?

title: II Corinthians 11:30
text: If boast I must, it shall be concerning my weakness.

title: II Corinthians 11:31
text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, he who is blessed forever, knows that I am telling the truth.

title: II Corinthians 11:32
text: In Damascus, the governor under Aretas the King, kept guard over the city of the Damascus, to arrest me;

title: II Corinthians 11:33
text: but through an opening in the wall I was let down in a basket, and so escaped and out of his hands.

title: II Corinthians 12:1
text: I am forced to boast, though it is unprofitable, but I will go on to visions and revelations of the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 12:2
text: I know a Christian man who, fourteen years ago (whether in the body I know not, or out of the body, I know not. God knows), was caught up--this man of whom I speak--even into the third heaven.

title: II Corinthians 12:3
text: And I know such a man (whether in the body or apart from the body I know not, God knows),

title: II Corinthians 12:4
text: who was caught up into Paradise, and heard unutterable words which no human being is permitted to utter.

title: II Corinthians 12:5
text: Of such a one I will boast; but on my own behalf I will not boast except in my weaknesses.

title: II Corinthians 12:6
text: If I should choose to continue boasting I should not be foolish, for I should be speaking the truth. But I refrain, lest by the stupendous grandeur of the revelation any one should estimate me beyond what he sees in me, or hears from me.

title: II Corinthians 12:7
text: It was for this reason, lest I should be over-elated, that there was given me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan, to buffet me, lest I should be over-elated.

title: II Corinthians 12:8
text: Concerning this, three times over I supplicated the Lord that it might leave me;

title: II Corinthians 12:9
text: but he has answered me: "My grace is sufficient for you; it is in weakness that my power is perfected."

title: II Corinthians 12:10
text: Most gladly therefore will I boast rather of my weakness, that over me like a tent may be pitched the power of Christ. That is why I rejoice in weakness, in ill-treatment, in troubles, in persecutions and calamities for Christ's sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

title: II Corinthians 12:11
text: I am become a fool--you have forced me to; for you yourselves ought to have been my vindicators. In no respect am I inferior to these superapostolic apostles, even though I am nothing.

title: II Corinthians 12:12
text: In truth the signs of the true apostle were wrought among you in all patience by signs and marvels and powers.

title: II Corinthians 12:13
text: In what respect, then, were you inferior to the other churches, except that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

title: II Corinthians 12:14
text: And now for the third time I am preparing to visit you. I will not be a burden to you, for I am not seeking yours, but you. For the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

title: II Corinthians 12:15
text: For my part, I will most gladly spend, yea, and will myself be spent, for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I to be loved the less?

title: II Corinthians 12:16
text: But though it be granted that I was not a burden to you, yet, you say, this was my cunning with which I caught you by a trick.

title: II Corinthians 12:17
text: Did I make gain of you through any of those whom I sent to you?

title: II Corinthians 12:18
text: I urged Titus to go, and with him I sent our brother. Did Titus make gain of you? And did I not walk in the same spirit as he did? Did I not take the very same steps?

title: II Corinthians 12:19
text: Do you think that all this time I am defending myself to you? It is before the presence of God that I am speaking in Christ; and all, beloved, for your upbuilding.

title: II Corinthians 12:20
text: For I dread that perhaps, when I come, I may not find you to be such as I wish, and that I may be found by you such as you do not wish; I dread lest there should be quarrels, jealousy, tempers, party spirit, slandering, gossip, arrogance, tumults;

title: II Corinthians 12:21
text: and lest when I come again my God may humble me before you, and lest I shall mourn for many those who have sinned before, and have not repented of the impurity and immorality and wantonness which they have practised.

title: II Corinthians 13:1
text: This will be my third visit to you. Out of the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be confirmed.

title: II Corinthians 13:2
text: I have said formerly, and I now forewarn you as when I was present the second time, so now when I am absent the second time, so now when I am absent, saying to those who had sinned before, and to all the rest, "If I come again, I will not spare,"

title: II Corinthians 13:3
text: Since you want a proof of Christ who is speaking in me, he who is not feeble toward you, but powerful among you.

title: II Corinthians 13:4
text: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he now lives through the power of God. I also am weak, sharing in his weakness, but I shall live with him by the power of God.

title: II Corinthians 13:5
text: Examine yourselves to see if you are in the faith; put your own selves to the proof. Or do you not know, your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you, unless indeed you fail to abide the proof?

title: II Corinthians 13:6
text: But I hope you will find that I abide the proof.

title: II Corinthians 13:7
text: And my prayer to God is that you may do no evil; not in order that I may appear approved, but that you may do what is noble, though I should seem unable to abide the proof.

title: II Corinthians 13:8
text: For I have no power against the truth, but only in defense of the truth.

title: II Corinthians 13:9
text: For I am always glad whenever I am weak, but you are strong. For this also I am praying, for your perfect reformation.

title: II Corinthians 13:10
text: For this reason I am writing thus while absent, so that when I come, I may not have to deal sharply, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for pulling down.

title: II Corinthians 13:11
text: Finally, brothers, farewell. Aim at perfection, take courage, be of one mind, live in peace; so shall the God of love and peace be with you.

title: II Corinthians 13:12
text: Salute one another with a holy kiss.

title: II Corinthians 13:13
text: All the saints salute you.

title: II Corinthians 13:14
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

title: Galatians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle sent not from men nor by any man, but by Jesus Christ and by God the Father who raised him from the dead;

title: Galatians 1:2
text: with all the brothers who are with me: To the churches of Galatia greeting.

title: Galatians 1:3
text: Grace be to you, and peace from God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Galatians 1:4
text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil age in accordance with the will of our God and Father,

title: Galatians 1:5
text: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.

title: Galatians 1:6
text: I am amazed that you are so soon shifting your ground, and deserting him who called you by the grace of Christ,

title: Galatians 1:7
text: for another gospel, which indeed is not another; only there are certain individuals who are troubling you, and desiring to pervert the gospel of Christ.

title: Galatians 1:8
text: But even though I myself or an angel from heaven were to preach any gospel other than that which I did preach to you, let him be accursed.

title: Galatians 1:9
text: I have said it before, and I now repeat it, if any one is preaching a gospel to you other than that which you have received, let him be accursed.

title: Galatians 1:10
text: Think you that I am now trying to conciliate men or God? Or am I "seeking to please men"? If I were still seeking to please men, I should not be a slave of Christ.

title: Galatians 1:11
text: For I would have you know, brothers, that the gospel I preach is not man-made;

title: Galatians 1:12
text: for neither did I myself receive it from man, nor by man was I taught it, but by a revelation [an apocalypse] of Jesus Christ.

title: Galatians 1:13
text: For you have heard of my former conduct in Judaism, how furiously I used to persecute the church of God, and how I kept seeking to root it out;

title: Galatians 1:14
text: and how in my zeal for Judaism I outstripped many of my own age and nation, in my special zeal for the traditions of my forefathers.

title: Galatians 1:15
text: But when God who had set me apart from my very birth,

title: Galatians 1:16
text: and had called me by his grace, was pleased to reveal his Son in me, so that I might preach his gospel among the Gentiles, without consulting a human being,

title: Galatians 1:17
text: or even going up to Jerusalem to see those who had been apostles before me, I went off at once to Arabia, and on my return came back to Damascus.

title: Galatians 1:18
text: Then three years later I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Peter, and spent two weeks with him.

title: Galatians 1:19
text: I saw no other apostle except James, the Lord's brother.

title: Galatians 1:20
text: (In what I am now writing, I call God to witness that I am telling the truth.)

title: Galatians 1:21
text: Then I went into the districts of Syria and Cilicia.

title: Galatians 1:22
text: But to the churches of Christ in Judea I was personally unknown;

title: Galatians 1:23
text: only they used to hear it said, "He who was once persecuting us is now preaching the gospel of the very faith which he once tried to ruin."

title: Galatians 1:24
text: And they were giving glory to God on my account.

title: Galatians 2:1
text: Fourteen years later I went up to Jerusalem again, with Barnabas, and took Titus also with me

title: Galatians 2:2
text: (I went up at that time in obedience to a revelation). And I laid before them the gospel which I am wont to preach among the Gentiles. I did this privately before those in authority, lest by any means I should be running, or should already have run, in vain.

title: Galatians 2:3
text: But although Titus, my companion, was a Greek, they did not compel even him to be circumcised.

title: Galatians 2:4
text: Yet there were false brethren who had crept in to spy out the freedom we enjoy in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us again.

title: Galatians 2:5
text: To them we did not yield submission even for an hour, in order that the truth of the gospel might abide unshaken among you.

title: Galatians 2:6
text: But those in authority--what they once were makes no difference to me; God is no respecter of persons--those I say who were in authority had no additions to make my message.

title: Galatians 2:7
text: On the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the gospel for the uncircumcised, just as Peter has with the gospel for the circumcised

title: Galatians 2:8
text: (for he who has equipped Peter for the apostleship to the circumcised, equipped me also for the apostleship to the Gentiles),

title: Galatians 2:9
text: and when they recognized the grace which had been given to me, James and Cephas and John, then thought to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and to me the right hand of fellowship. They agreed that we should go to the Gentiles and they to the Jews.

title: Galatians 2:10
text: They stipulated only that we should remember the poor, which very thing indeed I was quite eager to do.

title: Galatians 2:11
text: But when Cephas came to Antioch I resisted him to his face, because he stood self-condemned.

title: Galatians 2:12
text: For until certain men came from James he used to eat with the Gentile Christians, but when they came, he began to draw back and to separate himself, because he was afraid of the circumcision party.

title: Galatians 2:13
text: And the rest of the Jewish Christians also dissimulated with him, so that even Barnabas was carried away by their hypocrisy.

title: Galatians 2:14
text: But when I saw that they were not walking a straight path, in the presence of the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas before them all: "If you, although you are a Jew, live like the Gentiles and not like the Jews, why do you try to compel the Gentiles to become Jews?

title: Galatians 2:15
text: "We are Jews by birth, and not `Gentile sinners';

title: Galatians 2:16
text: "yet because we know that no man is justified by the works of the Law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, we ourselves also have put our faith in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the Law; for "By the works of the Law shall no flesh be justified."

title: Galatians 2:17
text: But if while seeking to be justified in Christ we ourselves also have been found to be sinners, is Christ then a minister of sin? Far from it!

title: Galatians 2:18
text: For if I am rebuilding the very things which I destroyed, I am proving myself a transgressor.

title: Galatians 2:19
text: For it is through law I died to law, in order to live to God.

title: Galatians 2:20
text: I have been crucified with Christ, so it is no longer I who am living, but it is Christ who is living in me; and the life I am now living in the flesh, I am living in faith of the Son of God who loved me and gave himself up for me.

title: Galatians 2:21
text: I do not annul the grace of God; for if righteousness comes by way of the Law, then indeed Christ died Christ for nothing.

title: Galatians 3:1
text: O foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you? You, before whose very eyes Jesus Christ was placarded as crucified!

title: Galatians 3:2
text: Answer me this one question: "When you received the Spirit, was it from doing what the Law commands or from believing the message heard?"

title: Galatians 3:3
text: Are you so without sense? After beginning with the Spirit, will you now end with the flesh?

title: Galatians 3:4
text: Did you have such experience to no purpose--if indeed it was really to no purpose?

title: Galatians 3:5
text: Does he then who supplies you with his Spirit and works miracles among you, do it because you do what the law commands of because you believe the message heard?

title: Galatians 3:6
text: Even as Abraham believed God and it was counted to him for righteousness?

title: Galatians 3:7
text: Notice then that the true sons of Abraham are children of faith.

title: Galatians 3:8
text: And the Scripture, anticipating God's justification of the Gentiles by faith, announced the gospel to Abraham beforehand in the words, In thee shall all the Gentiles be blessed.

title: Galatians 3:9
text: So then they who are children of faith are blessed with Abraham the faithful;

title: Galatians 3:10
text: but a curse rests on those who have their root in the works of the Law; for it is written: Cursed is every one that continues not in all the things written in the Book of the Law, to do them.

title: Galatians 3:11
text: And it is manifest that by the Law no man is justified in the sight of God: because The just shall live by faith,

title: Galatians 3:12
text: and the Law has nothing to do with faith, but declares, The man that has done these things shall live therein.

title: Galatians 3:13
text: Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the Law by becoming a curse for us (for it is written, Cursed is every one who is hanged upon a tree),

title: Galatians 3:14
text: to the end that in Christ Jesus the blessing of Abraham might come upon the Gentiles, so that through faith we might receive the promised Spirit.

title: Galatians 3:15
text: Let me illustrate, brothers, from every-day life. When once a human testament is made, and formally ratified, no one sets it aside or adds to it.

title: Galatians 3:16
text: Now it was to Abraham that the promises were spoken, and to his offspring. God did not say, "offsprings" as if speaking of many, but "and to your offspring," as of one; and this is Christ.

title: Galatians 3:17
text: I mean to say that the testament which God has already ratified could not be annulled by the Law which came four hundred and thirty years later, so as to make the Promise void.

title: Galatians 3:18
text: For if the inheritance comes from law, it no longer comes from a promise; but God did give it as a free gift to Abraham by a promise.

title: Galatians 3:19
text: To what purpose, then, was the Law? It was imposed later for the sake of transgressions, until the "Offspring" should come to whom the promise had been made. It was arranged through angels by the hand of a mediator.

title: Galatians 3:20
text: (Now a mediator implies more than one person, but God is only one.)

title: Galatians 3:21
text: Is the Law then opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not; for if a law had been given which could make alive, then righteousness would actually have come from law;

title: Galatians 3:22
text: but the Scripture has shut up the whole world in prison together under sin, in order that the promise due to faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who have faith.

title: Galatians 3:23
text: Before the Faith came we were perpetual prisoners under the Law, in preparation for the destined faith about to be revealed.

title: Galatians 3:24
text: So the Law has been our tutor-slave [our pedagogue] to lead us to Christ, so that we may be justified by faith;

title: Galatians 3:25
text: but now that the Faith is come, we are no longer under a tutor-slave.

title: Galatians 3:26
text: You are all sons of God through your faith in Jesus Christ.

title: Galatians 3:27
text: For all of you who were baptized into Christ, have clothed yourselves with Christ.

title: Galatians 3:28
text: In him there is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is no male and female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 3:29
text: And if you belong to Christ, then you are the descendants of Abraham, heirs according to the promise.

title: Galatians 4:1
text: What I mean is this: As long as the heir is a child, he differs in no respect from a slave, though he be the owner of the whole inheritance;

title: Galatians 4:2
text: but is under the control of guardians and trustees, until the time appointed by his father.

title: Galatians 4:3
text: So we Jews also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the empty externalities of the world.

title: Galatians 4:4
text: But when the fulness of time was come God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under law,

title: Galatians 4:5
text: to redeem from captivity those under law, in order that we might receive our sonship.

title: Galatians 4:6
text: And because you are sons, God sent forth the spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, "Dear, dear Father!"

title: Galatians 4:7
text: So each one of you is no longer a slave, but a son, and if a son, then an heir, too, through God's grace.

title: Galatians 4:8
text: But once, when you Gentiles had no knowledge of God, you were slaves to gods which have no real being.

title: Galatians 4:9
text: Now, however, when you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how is it that you are beginning to turn back to those weak and beggarly externalities, eager to be in bondage to them again?

title: Galatians 4:10
text: You are scrupulous, are you, in observing "days" and "months" and "seasons" and "years"?

title: Galatians 4:11
text: I am alarmed about you for fear lest I may have bestowed labor on you to no purpose.

title: Galatians 4:12
text: Brothers, I beseech you, become as I am, because I also have become as you are. You never did me any wrong;

title: Galatians 4:13
text: on the contrary, you know that although it was illness which brought about my preaching the gospel to you at my first visit,

title: Galatians 4:14
text: and although my bodily affliction was a trial to you, you did not scoff at it nor spurn me, but welcomed me like an angel of God, like Christ Jesus himself.

title: Galatians 4:15
text: Why then did you account yourselves so happy? (For I bear you witness that if you could you would have torn out your own eyes and given them to me.)

title: Galatians 4:16
text: Am I then become your enemy, because I am telling you the truth?

title: Galatians 4:17
text: These men are courting your favor to no good purpose. They want to isolate you, so that you will be courting their favor.

title: Galatians 4:18
text: It is always an honorable thing to have your favor sought in an honorable cause, always, and not only when I am with you.

title: Galatians 4:19
text: O my little children, of whom I travail again in birth until Christ be formed within you!

title: Galatians 4:20
text: How I wish I could be with you now, that I might change my tone; for I am perplexed about you.

title: Galatians 4:21
text: Tell me, you who wish to be subject to the Law, why do you not listen to the Law?

title: Galatians 4:22
text: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and one by the free woman;

title: Galatians 4:23
text: but while the son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, the son by the free woman was born in fulfilment of a promise.

title: Galatians 4:24
text: Now all this is an allegory, for these women are the two covenants; one from Mount Sinai, which is Hagar bearing children into bondage

title: Galatians 4:25
text: (for the word Hagar stands for Mt. Sinai in Arabia and represents the present Jerusalem who with her children is in bondage.)

title: Galatians 4:26
text: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

title: Galatians 4:27
text: For it is written, Rejoice, O thou barren one who dost never bear, Break forth in joy, thou that dost not travail; For the children of the desolate woman are many. Yea, more than hers who has a husband.

title: Galatians 4:28
text: But you, brothers, are like Isaac, children of the promise;

title: Galatians 4:29
text: but just as in old times the son born by the flesh used to persecute the son born by the power of the Spirit, so also it is now.

title: Galatians 4:30
text: But what does the Scripture say? Send away the slave-woman and her son; for the slave's son shall not be heir along with the son of the free woman.

title: Galatians 4:31
text: So, brothers, we are the children of no slave woman, but of free woman. For freedom did not Christ set us free;

title: Galatians 5:1
text: stand firm then, and do not be again entangled in a yoke of bondage.

title: Galatians 5:2
text: Listen to me! I, Paul, declare to you that if you are to continue to follow the rite of circumcision, Christ will be no profit to you.

title: Galatians 5:3
text: I solemnly testify to every man who submits to circumcision that he obligates himself to keep the whole Law.

title: Galatians 5:4
text: If you are being justified by law, you are cut off from Christ; you are fallen away from grace.

title: Galatians 5:5
text: But we are not, for we through the Spirit are eagerly waiting by faith for a hope of righteousness (a hope well founded);

title: Galatians 5:6
text: because in Christ neither circumcision has any value, nor uncircumcision, but faith which works through love.

title: Galatians 5:7
text: You were running your race nobly. Who hindered you from obeying the truth?

title: Galatians 5:8
text: The influence brought to bear does not come from him who is calling you.

title: Galatians 5:9
text: A little leaven is leavening the whole lump.

title: Galatians 5:10
text: As for me, I am fully trusting you in the Lord that you will be no otherwise minded; but he who is trying to unsettle you will have to bear his punishment, whoever he may be.

title: Galatians 5:11
text: But I, brothers, if I "still preach circumcision," why am I still persecuted? Then surely the stumbling-block of the Cross has ceased to be an obstacle!

title: Galatians 5:12
text: Would to God that those who are trying to unsettle you would even have themselves mutilated.

title: Galatians 5:13
text: For you, brothers, were called for freedom; only do not make your freedom an excuse for self-indulgence, but in love enslave yourselves to one another.

title: Galatians 5:14
text: For the whole Law has been fulfilled in this one precept, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

title: Galatians 5:15
text: But if you are always biting and devouring one another, take heed lest you be utterly consumed one by another.

title: Galatians 5:16
text: This is my meaning: Let your steps be guided by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

title: Galatians 5:17
text: For the desire of the flesh is against that of the Spirit, and the desire of the Spirit is against that of the flesh, for they two are antagonistic, so that you may not do those things that you wish.

title: Galatians 5:18
text: But if you are habitually led by the Spirit you are not under law.

title: Galatians 5:19
text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest; such, for instance, as fornication, impurity, indecency,

title: Galatians 5:20
text: idol-worship, sorcery, quarrels, party-spirit, jealousy, passionate anger, intrigues, factions, sectarianism,

title: Galatians 5:21
text: envy, drunkenness, revelings, and things like these. I tell you beforehand, as I have already told you, that those who practise such sins shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

title: Galatians 5:22
text: But the harvest-fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, fidelity, gentleness, and self-control;

title: Galatians 5:23
text: against such there is no law.

title: Galatians 5:24
text: And those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and appetites.

title: Galatians 5:25
text: If we are living by the Spirit, let us also keep step in the Spirit.

title: Galatians 5:26
text: Let us not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another.

title: Galatians 6:1
text: Even if any one should be overtaken in a fault, brothers, you that are spiritual ought, in a gentle spirit, to restore such a one, each one of you looking to himself, lest you too be tempted.

title: Galatians 6:2
text: Ever be bearing one another's burdens, and so be fulfilling the law of Christ.

title: Galatians 6:3
text: If a man fancies himself to be somebody when he is really nobody he is deceiving himself.

title: Galatians 6:4
text: Let each one test his own work, and he will then have something to be proud of by comparing himself with himself, and not with any one else;

title: Galatians 6:5
text: for every one must carry his own pack load.

title: Galatians 6:6
text: He, however, who is being taught in the message, should always share with his instructor in all the good things which he possesses.

title: Galatians 6:7
text: Be not deceived. God is not mocked. Whatever a man sows, that will he also reap.

title: Galatians 6:8
text: The man who is sowing to his flesh will of the flesh reap corruption; but he who is sowing to the Spirit will of the Spirit reap life eternal.

title: Galatians 6:9
text: And let us not be weary in well-doing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not.

title: Galatians 6:10
text: So then, as we have opportunity, let is do good to all men, but especially to those who are of the household of faith.

title: Galatians 6:11
text: See with what large letters I have written to you in my own handwriting!

title: Galatians 6:12
text: Those who are trying to compel you to be circumcised are such as wish to make a fair show in the flesh, only that they may not suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

title: Galatians 6:13
text: Even those who are being circumcised, are not themselves keeping the Law, but they want you to be circumcised so that they may glory in your flesh.

title: Galatians 6:14
text: God forbid that I should glory in anything except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, upon which the world has been crucified to me and I have been crucified to the world.

title: Galatians 6:15
text: For in Jesus Christ neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

title: Galatians 6:16
text: On all who will govern their lives by this rule and on the Israel of God may peace and mercy rest.

title: Galatians 6:17
text: From this time forth let no one trouble me, for I bear branded in my body the marks of Jesus, my Master.

title: Galatians 6:18
text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

title: Ephesians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints who are in Ephesus and to the faithful in Christ Jesus,

title: Ephesians 1:2
text: grace to you and peace from God our father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Ephesians 1:3
text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms in Christ.

title: Ephesians 1:4
text: Even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world to be holy and without blemish in his sight.

title: Ephesians 1:5
text: For in his love he predestined us (such was the good pleasure of his will) to adoption for himself as sons through Jesus Christ,

title: Ephesians 1:6
text: and to the praise of his glorious grace which he graciously bestowed upon us in the Beloved.

title: Ephesians 1:7
text: It is in him we have deliverance, the forgiveness of our trespasses, through his blood;

title: Ephesians 1:8
text: so abundantly did he lavish upon us the riches of his grace in all wisdom and understanding,

title: Ephesians 1:9
text: when he made known to us, I say, that good pleasure which he purposed in himself

title: Ephesians 1:10
text: for the government of the fulness of the ages, that all things in heaven and earth are alike should be gathered up in Christ, as Head.

title: Ephesians 1:11
text: It is he in whom we [Jews] also have our inheritance, having been chosen beforehand according to the purpose of Him who executes all things according to the counsel of his will,

title: Ephesians 1:12
text: that we who first hoped in Christ should be for the praise of his glory.

title: Ephesians 1:13
text: And in him, because you listened to the proclamation of the truth, the evangel of your salvation, and trusted it, you Gentiles too were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

title: Ephesians 1:14
text: who for the praise of his glory is the pledge of our common heritage, unto the complete redemption of his purchased property.

title: Ephesians 1:15
text: For this reason I also, from the time when I heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which prevails among you, and your love to all the saints,

title: Ephesians 1:16
text: do not cease to praise God for you, whenever I mention you in my prayers.

title: Ephesians 1:17
text: I am praying that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father most glorious, may grant you a spirit of wisdom and revelation, through an intimate knowledge of himself;

title: Ephesians 1:18
text: and that the eyes of your heart may be flooded with light so that you may understand what is the hope of his calling, what the wealth of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

title: Ephesians 1:19
text: and what the surpassing greatness of his might in us who believe, as seen in the energy of that resistless might

title: Ephesians 1:20
text: which he exercised in raising Christ from the dead, and in seating him at his right hand in the heavenly heights,

title: Ephesians 1:21
text: far above all hierarchies and authorities and powers and dominions and every name that is named, not only in this age but in that which is to come.

title: Ephesians 1:22
text: God has put all things under Christ's feet, and placed him as Head over all in the church,

title: Ephesians 1:23
text: which is his body, the fulness of Him who fills the universe.

title: Ephesians 2:1
text: And so God has given life to you [Gentiles] also, who were once dead in your trespasses and sins,

title: Ephesians 2:2
text: in which you passed your lives after the way of this world, under the sway of the Prince of the Powers of the Air, the spirit who is now working among the sons of disobedience.

title: Ephesians 2:3
text: And among them we all once passed our lives, indulging the passions of our flesh, carrying out the dictates of our senses and temperament, and were by nature the children of wrath like all the rest.

title: Ephesians 2:4
text: But God, who is rich in mercy, because of the great love with which he loved us,

title: Ephesians 2:5
text: even while we were dead in our trespasses, made us live together with Christ (it is by grace you have been saved):

title: Ephesians 2:6
text: together with him He raised us from the dead, and together with Christ Jesus seated us in the heavenly realm,

title: Ephesians 2:7
text: in order that he might show to the ages to come the amazing riches of his grace by his goodness to us in Christ Jesus.

title: Ephesians 2:8
text: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is God's gift.

title: Ephesians 2:9
text: It is not of works, so that any one can boast of it;

title: Ephesians 2:10
text: for we are his handiwork, created in Christ Jesus for good deeds, which God predestined us to make our daily way of life.

title: Ephesians 2:11
