title: James 3:6
text: And the tongue is a fire; it is a very world of iniquity among our members, defiling the whole body, and setting on fire the wheel of nature, and is itself set on fire by hell.

title: James 3:7
text: For while every kind of beast and bird, and of reptiles and sea-creatures are tamable, and actually have been tamed by mankind,

title: James 3:8
text: no man can tame the tongue, restless evil that it is, full of deadly poison.

title: James 3:9
text: With it we continually bless our Lord and Father, and with it we are accustomed to curse men made in the image of God.

title: James 3:10
text: From out of the same mouth pour forth blessings and cursings! My brothers, this ought not to be so.

title: James 3:11
text: Does a spring pour forth from the same opening sweet water and bitter?

title: James 3:12
text: Can a fig tree, my brothers, bear olives; or a grape-vine, figs? No more can salt water yield fresh water.

title: James 3:13
text: Who among you is wise and intelligent? Let him show his deeds by his good life, in the meekness of wisdom.

title: James 3:14
text: But if you have bitter jealousy and faction in your heart, do not be boasting of that, and be false to the truth.

title: James 3:15
text: Such wisdom is not that which is descending from on high, but is earthly, sensual, demonlike.

title: James 3:16
text: For wherever jealousy and faction exist, there is confusion and every evil deed.

title: James 3:17
text: But the wisdom which comes from on high is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, conciliatory, overflowing with mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without insincerity.

title: James 3:18
text: And the fruit of righteousness is being sown in peace by those who are working peace.

title: James 4:1
text: Where do the conflicts and quarrels that go on among you come from? Do they not come from your passions which are always making war among your bodily members?

title: James 4:2
text: You continually crave and do not obtain; you are killing and coveting and cannot acquire; you are fighting and at war. You do not have, because you do not ask.

title: James 4:3
text: You continue to ask and do not receive, because you are asking with a wrong purpose, in order to spend it upon your pleasures.

title: James 4:4
text: You adulteresses, do you not know that the friendship of the world is enmity to God? Whoever, then, desires to be a friend of the world, makes himself and enemy of God.

title: James 4:5
text: Or do you suppose that it is in vain that the Scripture says, "The spirit which has its home in us yearns over us unto jealousy?"

title: James 4:6
text: But he gives more and more grace: therefore it is said, God ever resists the proud; but to the humble he gives grace continually.

title: James 4:7
text: So then ever be subject to God, Ever resist the devil and he will flee from you.

title: James 4:8
text: Draw near to God And he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, And purify your hearts, you double-minded.

title: James 4:9
text: Lament and mourn, and weep aloud! Let your laughter be turned into mourning, And your joy into gloom!

title: James 4:10
text: Humble yourselves before the Lord, And he will raise you up.

title: James 4:11
text: Do not be talking against each other, brothers. He who is talking against a brother and condemning his brothers is talking against the Law and condemning the Law. But if you are condemning the Law, you are not a doer of the Law, but a judge.

title: James 4:12
text: But One is your Lawgiver and Judge--he who is able to save and to destroy. But you, who are you, to be condemning your neighbor?

title: James 4:13
text: Go to now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we shall journey to such a city and spend a year there, and trade and make money,"

title: James 4:14
text: when all the time you do not know what will happen on the morrow. For what is your life? You are but a mist, appearing for a brief time, and then vanishing.

title: James 4:15
text: You ought instead to say, "If the Lord wills it, we shall live and do this or that."

title: James 4:16
text: But now you are glorying in these insolent boastings of yours; all such glorying is evil.

title: James 4:17
text: So to him who knows how to do right and does not do it, to him it is sin.

title: James 5:1
text: Go to now, you rich men! Weep aloud, howl for the miseries which are about to come upon you!

title: James 5:2
text: For your riches lie rotting, and your clothing has become moth-eaten.

title: James 5:3
text: Your gold and silver are rusted: and their rust will be for a testimony against you, and it will eat your flesh. For you have been storing up fire in these last days!

title: James 5:4
text: Look! the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have been keeping back by fraud, are crying aloud! And the cries of the reapers have entered into the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth!

title: James 5:5
text: You have lived luxuriously on earth, you have taken your pleasure, you have fattened your hearts for a day of slaughter.

title: James 5:6
text: You have condemned, you have murdered the righteous man unresisting!

title: James 5:7
text: Be patient, then, brothers, till the coming of the Lord. Behold the farmer who waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it gets the early and the latter rains.

title: James 5:8
text: So you also must be patient. Stablish your hearts; for the coming of the Lord is at hand!

title: James 5:9
text: Do not make complaints against each other, brothers, lest you yourselves be condemned. Behold the Judge is standing before the very door!

title: James 5:10
text: Take, my brothers, for an example the suffering and the patience of the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

title: James 5:11
text: Remember we count those that were stedfast happy. You have heard of the stedfastness of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord with him, seen how the Lord is full of tenderness.

title: James 5:12
text: Again, above all things, my brothers, swear not at all, neither by the heavens, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath. Let your "yes" be "yes," and your "no," "no," so you will not fall under condemnation.

title: James 5:13
text: Is any one of you in trouble? Let him pray.

title: James 5:14
text: Is any in good spirits? Let him sing unto his harp. Is any one of you ill? Let him send for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, after anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

title: James 5:15
text: and the prayer of faith will restore the sick, and the Lord will raise him up. And if he has committed sins, it will be forgiven him.

title: James 5:16
text: So confess your sins one to another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. For the fervent prayer of a righteous man is mighty in its working.

title: James 5:17
text: Elijah was a man of like passions with us, and he prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

title: James 5:18
text: Then he prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

title: James 5:19
text: My brothers, if any one of you strays from the truth, and some one brings him back,

title: James 5:20
text: let him know that he who brings a sinner back from the error of his ways, saves his soul from death, and hides a multitude of sins.

title: I Peter 1:1
text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Roman Asia, and Bithynia,

title: I Peter 1:2
text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ; Grace and peace be multiplied to you.

title: I Peter 1:3
text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whose great mercy we have been born anew into a living hope, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead;

title: I Peter 1:4
text: and into an inheritance imperishable and undefiled and fadeless, which has been kept in heaven for you

title: I Peter 1:5
text: who, through faith, are continuously guarded by the power of God for a salvation, ready to be revealed in the last days.

title: I Peter 1:6
text: Exult in this, though now for a brief moment, if need be, you have suffered many hardships.

title: I Peter 1:7
text: These are in order that the test of your faith, more precious than gold that is perishable and yet is tested by fire, may redound to praise and glory and honor, at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

title: I Peter 1:8
text: Him you love, though you have never seen him; in him you ever believe, though even now you see him not, and you are rejoicing with joy unspeakable and full of glory,

title: I Peter 1:9
text: as you continually receive the reward of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

title: I Peter 1:10
text: Concerning this salvation the Prophets who prophesied regarding the grace intended for you, diligently sought and searched.

title: I Peter 1:11
text: They were searching to know to what time, or to what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them kept pointing, when he ever testified beforehand concerning the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow.

title: I Peter 1:12
text: It was revealed to them that it was not for themselves, but for you, that they were ministering the truths which have now been announced to you, by those who preached the gospel to you, through the help of the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven--truths into which angels long to look.

title: I Peter 1:13
text: So then brace up your minds, be steady in spirit, and fix your hope firmly in the grace that is coming to you, at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

title: I Peter 1:14
text: Like obedient children, do not fashion yourselves according to the former passions of your days of ignorance,

title: I Peter 1:15
text: but become yourselves holy in your whole manner of living, as He who has called you is holy,

title: I Peter 1:16
text: as the Scripture says, You shall be holy, because I am holy.

title: I Peter 1:17
text: And since you call upon him as Father, who impartially judges each one according to his deeds, pass the time of your sojourning here in reverence.

title: I Peter 1:18
text: For you well know that not with perishable things, with silver or gold, were you redeemed from the emptiness of your manner of life, received by tradition from your ancestors;

title: I Peter 1:19
text: but with precious blood, like that of a lamb without spot or blemish, even the blood of Christ.

title: I Peter 1:20
text: He was indeed foreknown before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of the times for your sake.

title: I Peter 1:21
text: Through him you believe in God who raised him from the dead and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope are now in God.

title: I Peter 1:22
text: Now that by obedience to the truth you have purified your lives for a brotherly love without hypocrisy, you must love one another from your hearts, fervently.

title: I Peter 1:23
text: For you have been born anew, not of perishable, but of imperishable seed, by the living, lasting word of God.

title: I Peter 1:24
text: For, All flesh is grass And all its glory like the flower of the grass. The grass fades, The flower falls,

title: I Peter 1:25
text: But the word of the Lord abides forever. And this is the word of the gospel which has been told to you.

title: I Peter 2:1
text: Therefore put away all malice, all deceit, insincerity, jealousy, and slander of every sort.

title: I Peter 2:2
text: Like new-born babes long for the pure spiritual milk to make you grow up into salvation;

title: I Peter 2:3
text: since you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

title: I Peter 2:4
text: Come to him then, that living Stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, and precious.

title: I Peter 2:5
text: And yourselves like living stones be built into a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood offering spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God, through Christ Jesus.

title: I Peter 2:6
text: For, as Scripture says: Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner-stone, elect, precious, And he who believes on Him shall never be put to shame.

title: I Peter 2:7
text: For you, then, that believe, is the preciousness; but for those who do not believe, A stone which the builders rejected, The same has become the head stone of the corner,

title: I Peter 2:8
text: and, A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense. They stumble over it because they are disobeying God's word, and to this they were also appointed.

title: I Peter 2:9
text: But you are an elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a purchased people, that you may show forth the virtues of Him who has called you out of darkness into his marvelous light--

title: I Peter 2:10
text: you who once were not a people, but now are the people of God; who were once without mercy, but now you have found mercy.

title: I Peter 2:11
text: I beseech you, beloved, as pilgrims and exiles, to abstain from passions of the flesh that war upon your souls.

title: I Peter 2:12
text: Let your manner of life before the Gentiles be honest; so that, although they are now slandering you as evil-doers, they may, by beholding your noble conduct, come to glorify God, in the day of visitation.

title: I Peter 2:13
text: Submit yourselves, for the Lord's sake, to every human authority; whether it be to the Emperor as supreme ruler,

title: I Peter 2:14
text: or to governors as sent by him for the punishment of evil-doers and for the encouragement of well-doers.

title: I Peter 2:15
text: For it is the will of God that by well-doing you should silence the ignorant talk of foolish men.

title: I Peter 2:16
text: Live like free men; and yet do not make your freedom a cloak for misconduct, but be the slaves of God.

title: I Peter 2:17
text: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Reverence God. Honor the Emperor.

title: I Peter 2:18
text: Household slaves, submit yourselves to your masters in all reverence; not only to the kind and gentle, but also to the unreasonable.

title: I Peter 2:19
text: For it is an acceptable thing to God, if from a sense of duty to him, a man endures a wrong, even suffering unjustly.

title: I Peter 2:20
text: For what credit is it if, when you are struck for a fault, you take it patiently? But if when you are doing well and suffer for it, you always take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

title: I Peter 2:21
text: For this is your calling; because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you should follow in his footsteps;

title: I Peter 2:22
text: He committed no sin, Neither was guile found in his mouth.

title: I Peter 2:23
text: He was reviled, and reviled not back. When he suffered he never threatened but always committed his cause to the One who judges rightly.

title: I Peter 2:24
text: He bore our sins in his own body upon the tree, in order that we might become dead to sins, and be alive unto righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed.

title: I Peter 2:25
text: For you were straying like lost sheep, but you are now returned to the Shepherd and Guardian of your souls.

title: I Peter 3:1
text: In the same way you wives must be submissive to your own husbands; so that if some of them will not believe the message, they may apart from the message be won over by the behavior of their wives,

title: I Peter 3:2
text: when they see how pure and reverent you are.

title: I Peter 3:3
text: Your adornment ought not to be the outward adornment of plaited hair and golden jewels and the wearing of beautiful dresses;

title: I Peter 3:4
text: but rather that hidden personality of the heart, the imperishable ornament of a quiet and gentle spirit, which in the sight of God is indeed precious.

title: I Peter 3:5
text: For in this way in the olden time the holy women also, who put their trust in God, used to adorn themselves. They were ever in submission to their own husbands;

title: I Peter 3:6
text: thus, for example, Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. And you are daughters of Sarah, if you do what is right, and permit nothing to make you afraid.

title: I Peter 3:7
text: In the same way you husbands live with your wives, according to knowledge, honoring your wife as of the weaker sex, yet as an heir with yourself of the grace of life; so that your prayers may not be hindered.

title: I Peter 3:8
text: Finally, you should all be harmonious, sympathetic, loving as brothers, tender-hearted, humble-minded;

title: I Peter 3:9
text: not paying back evil for evil or abuse for abuse, but on the contrary giving a blessing. Because for this you have been called--to inherit a blessing.

title: I Peter 3:10
text: He who would love life and enjoy happy days, Let him keep his tongue from evil, And his lips from speaking guile;

title: I Peter 3:11
text: Let him turn from evil and do good, Let him seek peace, and pursue it.

title: I Peter 3:12
text: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, And his ears are open to their cry; But the face of the Lord is set against evil-doers.

title: I Peter 3:13
text: Yet who will harm you if you become zealous for the good?

title: I Peter 3:14
text: But even if you should suffer in behalf of righteousness, you are happy. Do not be afraid of their terror, neither be troubled.

title: I Peter 3:15
text: But consecrate Christ in your hearts, as Lord. Be always in readiness to make and answer to any one who asks you a reason for the hope that is within you, yet with gentleness and reverence.

title: I Peter 3:16
text: See that you have a clear conscience, so that, although they speak of you as evil-doers, these libelers of your good Christian lives may be ashamed.

title: I Peter 3:17
text: For it is better that you suffer for doing right, if such be God's will, than for doing wrong;

title: I Peter 3:18
text: because Christ also once for all suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God. He was put to death in the flesh, but make alive in spirit.

title: I Peter 3:19
text: (It was in spirit that he went and preached the Word to the spirits who were in prison,

title: I Peter 3:20
text: who in old times had been disobedient, when God's longsuffering was waiting in the days of Noah, while an ark was building, in which a few persons--eight in number--were saved by water.)

title: I Peter 3:21
text: Baptism, the counterpart of that, now saves you (not the washing off of the filth of the flesh, but the prayer for a good conscience toward God), through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.

title: I Peter 3:22
text: He is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; to Him angels and authorities and powers have been made subject.

title: I Peter 4:1
text: Since, then, Christ suffered in the flesh, do you also ever arm yourselves with the same mind (because he who has suffered in the flesh has done with sin),

title: I Peter 4:2
text: so that in future you may not spend your life in the flesh according to men's desires, but in the will of God.

title: I Peter 4:3
text: For the time past of life may suffice us to have worked the will of the Gentiles, when we spent our life in lasciviousness, lusts, hard drinking, revelry, banqueting, and abominable idol worship.

title: I Peter 4:4
text: They are astonished at this, that you do not run into the same excesses of profligacy as they do; and they speak evil of you.

title: I Peter 4:5
text: But they must render account to Him who stands ready to judge the living and the dead.

title: I Peter 4:6
text: The gospel was preached for this cause to those who were dead also, that they might be judged according to men in flesh, but live according to God in spirit.

title: I Peter 4:7
text: But the end of all things is close at hand; so be sober, watch and pray.

title: I Peter 4:8
text: Above everything have fervent love to one another; for love veils a multitude of sins.

title: I Peter 4:9
text: Be hospitable to one another, without grudging.

title: I Peter 4:10
text: Whatever the gifts which each has received, use them for one another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

title: I Peter 4:11
text: If any one preaches, let him always preach as one who utters God's truth; if any one serves another, let it be with the strength which God supplies; so that in every way God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory and dominion for ever and ever, Amen.

title: I Peter 4:12
text: Do not think it strange, beloved, that a fiery ordeal has come to test you, as though some surprising thing had befallen you.

title: I Peter 4:13
text: But be glad in the degree in which you share in the sufferings of Christ; so that when his glory shall be revealed, you too may be glad with triumphant gladness.

title: I Peter 4:14
text: If you are being reproached for the name of Christ, you are blessed, for the spirit of glory and of God is resting upon you.

title: I Peter 4:15
text: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evil-doer, or as a spy upon other people's business.

title: I Peter 4:16
text: But if any man is suffering as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him ever glorify God in this Name.

title: I Peter 4:17
text: It is time for judgment to begin with the household of God; and if it first begin with us, what shall be the end of those who are disobedient to the gospel?

title: I Peter 4:18
text: If the righteous man is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

title: I Peter 4:19
text: So let those who are suffering according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well-doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

title: I Peter 5:1
text: Now to you who are presbyters I make this appeal; for I am myself a presbyter, and was a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory about to be revealed.

title: I Peter 5:2
text: Be shepherds to your flock of God; take charge of them willingly, and not through compulsion; not for filthy lucre, but with a willing mind;

title: I Peter 5:3
text: not by way of lording it over your heritage, but by becoming examples to the flock.

title: I Peter 5:4
text: Then, when the Chief Shepherd shall appear, you too will receive the fadeless wreath of glory.

title: I Peter 5:5
text: You younger men must submit to the presbyters; and all of you must put on the garment of humility and serve one another, for God resists the haughty, But gives grace to the humble.

title: I Peter 5:6
text: So humble yourselves under God's mighty hand, so that he may exalt you in due time.

title: I Peter 5:7
text: Cast all your care upon him, for he ever cares for you.

title: I Peter 5:8
text: Be temperate, be vigilant; because your enemy, the devil, is prowling about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

title: I Peter 5:9
text: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, knowing well that the same afflictions are being accomplished in your brothers that are in the world.

title: I Peter 5:10
text: But the God of all grace, who has called us by Christ Jesus to share his eternal glory, will, after you have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

title: I Peter 5:11
text: His is the dominion forever and ever; Amen.

title: I Peter 5:12
text: By Sylvanus, a faithful brother of yours, as I suppose, I have written you briefly, to comfort you, and to testify that this is the true grace of God. In this stand fast.

title: I Peter 5:13
text: Your sister church in Babylon, elect with you, sends you salutations, and so does Marcus, my son.

title: I Peter 5:14
text: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ Jesus.

title: II Peter 1:1
text: Simon Peter, a slave and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained an equally precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ:

title: II Peter 1:2
text: Grace and peace be multiplied to you by the God and Father of Jesus our Lord.

title: II Peter 1:3
text: For his power divine has granted to us everything needful for life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue.

title: II Peter 1:4
text: By these he has granted his promises to us, precious and splendid; so that through them you may become partners of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

title: II Peter 1:5
text: For this very reason do your best to add to your faith manliness, and to manliness knowledge,

title: II Peter 1:6
text: and to knowledge self-control, and to self-control stedfastness, and to stedfastness piety,

title: II Peter 1:7
text: and to piety brotherly love, and to brotherly love, love itself.

title: II Peter 1:8
text: For if these virtues are yours in abounding measure, they render you not idle nor unfruitful, until you come into the full knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:9
text: For the man who lacks these virtues is blind, short-sighted, forgetful of his cleansing from his old sins.

title: II Peter 1:10
text: So, brothers, take diligent care to make your calling and election sure; for if you do this, you will never stumble.

title: II Peter 1:11
text: For so the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ will be richly supplied to you.

title: II Peter 1:12
text: I shall therefore be always ready to remind you of all this, even though you know it, and are firmly founded in the truth which is with you.

title: II Peter 1:13
text: So I think it right, as long as I am in this "tent," to rouse you by way of reminding you,

title: II Peter 1:14
text: since I know that the time for me to strike tent comes swiftly on, even as our Lord Jesus Christ pointed out to me.

title: II Peter 1:15
text: So I will do my best to enable you, even after my departure, continually to call these things to mind.

title: II Peter 1:16
text: For we were not following cunningly devised fables, when we told you of the power and presence of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we had been eye-witnesses of his Majesty.

title: II Peter 1:17
text: For he did receive honor and glory from God the Father, when there was borne such a voice to him from the Majestic Glory, This is my Son, my Beloved, in whom I delight;

title: II Peter 1:18
text: and this voice we ourselves heard, borne to us out of heaven, when we were with him on the holy hill.

title: II Peter 1:19
text: And so we possess the word of prophecy made yet more sure. Unto this you do well to give heed as to a lamp shining in a dark place, till the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

title: II Peter 1:20
text: But first be assured of this--that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

title: II Peter 1:21
text: For no prophecy was ever brought by the will of man; but moved by the Holy Spirit, men spoke for God.

title: II Peter 2:1
text: But there were false prophets, too, among the people, just as among you also there will be false teachers. These will secretly bring in destructive sects, denying even the Master who bought them, and bringing swift ruin upon themselves.

title: II Peter 2:2
text: Then there will be many who will follow their immorality, because of whom the Way of the Truth will be maligned.

title: II Peter 2:3
text: In their covetousness, with cunning words, they will make merchandise of you; those whose doom has not been idle from of old, and whose destruction has not been slumbering.

title: II Peter 2:4
text: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to chains of darkness, and reserved them for judgment;

title: II Peter 2:5
text: if he did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when he brought a flood upon an ungodly world;

title: II Peter 2:6
text: if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and reduced them to ashes, thus holding them up as a warning to all who would live ungodly;

title: II Peter 2:7
text: and he delivered righteous Lot who was worn out by the lascivious life of the wicked

title: II Peter 2:8
text: (for that righteous man, living among them, tormented his righteous soul in seeing and hearing, day after day, their lawless deeds),

title: II Peter 2:9
text: then be sure that the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation, and to keep the wicked (who are even now enduring punishment) for the "Day of Judgment";

title: II Peter 2:10
text: especially those who spend their lives following the flesh in the lust of defilement, and in despising all authority. Audacious and wilful, they feel no awe in railing against dignities;

title: II Peter 2:11
text: even where angels, though surpassing them in strength and might, do not bring a railing judgment against them before the Lord.

title: II Peter 2:12
text: But these men, like irrational creatures, mere animals, born to be taken and destroyed, continually rail about matters of which they know nothing. In their corruption they will surely be destroyed,

title: II Peter 2:13
text: suffering wrong as the wage of wrong which they have done. These are men who count it pleasure to carouse in open daylight; they are spots and blemishes reveling in their deceit, even while they are feasting with you.

title: II Peter 2:14
text: They have eyes full of harlots, eyes that cannot stop sinning. They entice unsteady souls. Their heart is trained in greed. They are an accursed generation.

title: II Peter 2:15
text: They have forsaken the right way; they have lost their way, and followed the road of Balaam, the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrong-doing.

title: II Peter 2:16
text: He was, however, rebuked for his own transgression; a dumb ass spoke with a man's voice, and stopped the madness of the prophet.

title: II Peter 2:17
text: Such men are like waterless springs, or mists storm-driven; for them the blackness of darkness has been reserved.

title: II Peter 2:18
text: For speaking great swelling words of vanity, they entangle, by their lasciviousness, in the lusts of the flesh, those who are just about to escape from the men that live in misconduct.

title: II Peter 2:19
text: They promise them liberty, while they themselves are slaves of rottenness! (For indeed a man is the slave of anything which masters him.)

title: II Peter 2:20
text: For if, after having escaped the pollutions of the world, through the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, men are again entangled in them and overpowered, their last state is become worse than their first.

title: II Peter 2:21
text: Indeed it would have been better for them not to have known the Way of Righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy command delivered to them.

title: II Peter 2:22
text: In their case it has happened according to the true proverb, The dog returns again to his own vomit, and The sow, after washing, to her wallowing in the mire.

title: II Peter 3:1
text: This is now my second letter to you, beloved. In both of them I am stirring up your pure minds by putting you in remembrance.

title: II Peter 3:2
text: I want you to recollect the words that were foretold by the holy prophets, and the command of your Lord and Saviour, given you through your apostles.

title: II Peter 3:3
text: Know this first, that mockers will come in the last days, in their mockery, men who walk the way of their own lusts

title: II Peter 3:4
text: and say, "Where is the promise of His coming? For since the day that our fathers fell asleep everything continues as it was from the beginning of the creation."

title: II Peter 3:5
text: For they willingly ignore the fact that there were heaven, from of old, and an earth formed out of water and through water, by the word of God;

title: II Peter 3:6
text: and that by the same means the world which then existed was destroyed by a deluge of water.

title: II Peter 3:7
text: But the heavens and earth that now are, by the same word of God, have been reserved for fire, and are being kept for the Day of Judgment, and for the destruction of ungodly men.

title: II Peter 3:8
text: Do not forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

title: II Peter 3:9
text: The Lord does not loiter over his promise, as some men esteem loitering; but he is longsuffering toward you, not purposing that any should perish, but that all should pass on to repentance.

title: II Peter 3:10
text: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief; and on that Day the heavens will vanish with a crash, the heavenly bodies will melt with fervent heat, and the earth and all its works will be burned up.

title: II Peter 3:11
text: Now since all things are in the process of dissolution, what kind of men ought you to be, in all holy living and piety;

title: II Peter 3:12
text: while you look for and hasten the coming of the Day of God. At its coming the heavens, being on fire, will be dissolved, and the heavenly bodies will melt with fervent heat.

title: II Peter 3:13
text: But according to his promise, we are looking for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness makes her dwelling.

title: II Peter 3:14
text: And so, beloved, since you are looking for these things, continually give diligence that you may be found in peace, unspotted and blameless in his sight.

title: II Peter 3:15
text: Regard our Lord's longsuffering as salvation; even as our dear brother Paul also wrote to you, according to the wisdom given to him.

title: II Peter 3:16
text: It is the same in all his letters when he speaks of these things. There are indeed some things in his letters hard to understand, which the ignorant and the shifty wrest, as also they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

title: II Peter 3:17
text: Do you therefore, beloved, because you know these things beforehand, be on your guard lest you be led astray by the error of the wicked, and so fall from your own stedfastness.

title: II Peter 3:18
text: But grow continually in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and unto the Day of Eternity, Amen.

title: I John 1:1
text: It is of what has existed from the beginning, of what we have listened to, of what we have seen with our own eyes, of what we have witnessed and touched with our own heads, it is concerning the Logos of Life that we are now writing.

title: I John 1:2
text: And the Life was made visible, and we have seen it and are bearing witness, and are bringing you word of that Eternal Life which was face to face with the Father and was made visible to us.

title: I John 1:3
text: It is what we have seen and heard that we are announcing to you, in order that you also may have partnership with us; and our partnership is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

title: I John 1:4
text: And we are writing all this to you that our joy may be complete.

title: I John 1:5
text: This, then, is the message that we have heard from him, and are announcing to you, that God is light, and no darkness what ever is in him.

title: I John 1:6
text: If we say, "We have partnership with Him," when we are passing our life in the darkness, we are lying and are not doing the truth.

title: I John 1:7
text: But is we are passing our life in the light, as he is in the light, we ever have partnership with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ is cleansing us from every sin.

title: I John 1:8
text: If we say, "We have no sin," we are deceiving ourselves and the truth is not in us.

title: I John 1:9
text: But if we confess our sins, faithful is he and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all wrong-doing.

title: I John 1:10
text: If we say, "We have not sinned," we are making him a liar, and his word is not in us.

title: I John 2:1
text: My children, I am writing this to you that you may not continue to sin; but if any one sin, we ever have a Comforter before the Father, Jesus Christ the Righteous.

title: I John 2:2
text: And he is the propitiation for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for those of the whole world.

title: I John 2:3
text: This is how we may know that we have come to know Him, by always keeping his commandments.

title: I John 2:4
text: He who says, "I know Him," but does no continue obeying his commandments, is a liar,

title: I John 2:5
text: and the truth is not in him; bit if any man obey his word, in him truly is the love of God made perfect. By this we come to know that we are in him:

title: I John 2:6
text: By who says he "remains in him" ought to spend his life as he spent his.

title: I John 2:7
text: Beloved, I am not writing a new commandment to you, nay, and old commandment, which you have had from the beginning. That old commandment is the message to which you have listened.

title: I John 2:8
text: Yet again it is a new commandment which I am writing to you, which is true in him and is you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light is already shining.

title: I John 2:9
text: He who says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.

title: I John 2:10
text: But he who loves his brother is abiding in the light, and in it there is no cause of stumbling.

title: I John 2:11
text: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and is spending his life in the darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

title: I John 2:12
text: I am writing to you, little children, because you sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

title: I John 2:13
text: I am writing to you, fathers, because you have come to know him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have fully overcome the Evil One. I have written to you, little children, because you have learned to know the father.

title: I John 2:14
text: I have written to you, fathers, because you have learned to know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God is abiding in you, and you have fully overcome the Evil One.

title: I John 2:15
text: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

title: I John 2:16
text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the proud glory of life, is not from the Father, but from the world;

title: I John 2:17
text: and the world and its lusts are passing away, but he who ever does the will of God abides forever.

title: I John 2:18
text: My children, this is the last hour, and as you have heard that an antichrist was coming, and now many antichrists are already risen, whence we may know that it is the last hour.

title: I John 2:19
text: They came forth from us, but they did not belong to us. If they had belonged to us they would certainly have remained with us, but they went out that they might be manifest that they all are not of us.

title: I John 2:20
text: Now you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you know all things.

title: I John 2:21
text: I am not writing to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it, and know that no lie is of the truth.

title: I John 2:22
text: Who is the liar if not the man who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, even he who disowns the Father and the Son.

title: I John 2:23
text: Whoever denies the Son, the same has not the Father; but he who confesses the Son has the Father also. As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning abide in you.

title: I John 2:24
text: If what you have heard from the beginning is abiding in you, you also will ever abide in the Son and in the Father.

title: I John 2:25
text: And this is the promise which he has promised to us even life eternal.

title: I John 2:26
text: I have written this to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

title: I John 2:27
text: As to you, the unction you received from him remains ever in you, and you need no teaching from any one. But since his unction teaches you concerning all things and is true, and is no lie, abide continually in him, as it has taught you to do.

title: I John 2:28
text: And now continue to abide in him, my children, so that when he shall appear we may have cheerful confidence and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

title: I John 2:29
text: If you know that he is righteous you know also that every one who habitually practises righteousness has been born of him.

title: I John 3:1
text: Behold what manner of love the Father has given us in allowing us to be called "Children of God!" And that is what we are. For this reason the world does not recognize us, because it did not know him.

title: I John 3:2
text: We are God's children now, beloved; what we shall be has never yet been made manifest. But we know that when he is manifested we shall be like him; for we shall see him even as he is.

title: I John 3:3
text: And every one who is holding this hope in him is purifying himself, even as he is pure.

title: I John 3:4
text: Every one who commits sin commits also lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

title: I John 3:5
text: And you know that he was manifested to take away sins; and in him is no sin.

title: I John 3:6
text: Whoever continually abides in him does not habitually sin; whoever lives in sin has not seen him, nor come to know him.

title: I John 3:7
text: My children, let no one deceive you; he who is working righteousness is righteous, just as he is righteous.

title: I John 3:8
text: He who is committing sin is of the devil, because from the beginning of the devil is sinning. It was for this cause that the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

title: I John 3:9
text: Whoever is a child of God cannot go on sinning, because his seed is abiding in him; and he cannot go on sinning because he is a child of God.

title: I John 3:10
text: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil; for every one who does not work righteousness is not a child of God, nor is he who does not love his brother.

title: I John 3:11
text: For this is the message that you have listened to from the beginning, "WE ARE TO LOVE ONE ANOTHER."

title: I John 3:12
text: We are not to be like Cain, who belonged to the Evil One, and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? It was because his own deeds were evil, and his brother's, righteous.

title: I John 3:13
text: Do not wonder, brothers, if the world continues to hate you.

title: I John 3:14
text: We know that we have migrated, out of death into life, because we love our brothers. He who has no love is abiding in death.

title: I John 3:15
text: Every one who is hating his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.

title: I John 3:16
text: By this we learn to know love, because he laid down his life for us; so we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

title: I John 3:17
text: But whoever has this world's goods, and beholds his brother in need, and shuts up his heart against him, how can the love of God continue to abide in him?

title: I John 3:18
text: My children, let us not love in word nor in talk, but in deed and in truth.

title: I John 3:19
text: By this we shall come to know that we are really of the truth,

title: I John 3:20
text: and shall persuade our heart in his presence whenever our heart condemns us, because God is greater than our heart and knows all things.

title: I John 3:21
text: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, we have confidence toward God,

title: I John 3:22
text: and whatever we ask we are receiving from him, because we are keeping his commandments and doing those things that are pleasing in his sight.

title: I John 3:23
text: His commandment is this, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another as he has commanded us to do.

title: I John 3:24
text: He who keeps his commandments is abiding in Him, and Christ in him. By this we know that Christ is abiding in us, by the Spirit which he has given us.

title: I John 4:1
text: Do not believe every spirit, beloved, but test the spirits to see whether they are of God; for many false prophets are gone out into the world.

title: I John 4:2
text: By this you know the Spirit of God; every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is from God;

title: I John 4:3
text: and every spirit which confesses him not, is not from God. And this is that spirit of Antichrist of which you have heard that it is coming, and that now it is already in the world.

title: I John 4:4
text: My little children, you are of God and have conquered them; because he that is within you is greater than he that is in the world.

title: I John 4:5
text: They are of the world, and for this reason they speak as of the world, and the world listens to them.

title: I John 4:6
text: But you are of God. He who is beginning to know God listens to us; he who is not of God does not listen to us. By this we may distinguish the spirit of truth from the spirit of error.

title: I John 4:7
text: Beloved, let us love one another; for love is of God; and every one that loves us a child of God.

title: I John 4:8
text: He who does not love, does not know God; for God is love.

title: I John 4:9
text: In this was the love of God clearly shown toward us, by his sending his only Son into the world, so that we might live through him.

title: I John 4:10
text: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be a propitiation for our sins.

title: I John 4:11
text: If God so loved us, beloved, we also ought to love one another.

title: I John 4:12
text: No man has ever gazed on God; but if we love one another, God ever abides in us, and his love is perfected in us.

title: I John 4:13
text: By this we come to know that we are abiding in him, and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit;

title: I John 4:14
text: and we have beheld and do testify that the Father has sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

title: I John 4:15
text: If any man confesses that "Jesus is the Son of God." God is abiding in that man, and he in God.

title: I John 4:16
text: And we do know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love; and he who is abiding in love is abiding in God, and God is abiding in him.

title: I John 4:17
text: In this is love made perfect with us, so that we may have cheerful confidence in the Day of Judgment, because we are living in this world as He lives.

title: I John 4:18
text: Fear does not exist in love; but love, when it is perfect, drives out fear. For fear has always torment, and he who has fear is not yet perfected in love.

title: I John 4:19
text: We love because He loved us first.

title: I John 4:20
text: If any one says, "I love God," and yet hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen, cannot possibly love God, whom he has not seen.

title: I John 4:21
text: And we have this command from God: HE WHO LOVES GOD IS TO LOVE HIS BROTHER ALSO.

title: I John 5:1
text: Every one who believes that Jesus is the Christ is a child of God; and every one who loves the Father, loves him also who is the Father's Child.

title: I John 5:2
text: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and obey his commandments.

title: I John 5:3
text: For love to God means obeying his commandments; and his commandments are not irksome.

title: I John 5:4
text: For whoever is a child of God is overcoming the world; and our faith is the victory that has overcome the world.

title: I John 5:5
text: And who it the one that is overcoming the world if not the man who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

title: I John 5:6
text: Jesus Christ is he who came by water and blood, not by the water only, but by the water and by the blood. The spirit is he who bears testimony, because the Spirit is the truth.

title: I John 5:7
text: For there are three who bear testimony, the Spirit, and the water,

title: I John 5:8
text: and the blood; and the three are one.

title: I John 5:9
text: If we accept men's testimony, the testimony of God is greater; for this is the testimony of God, that he has borne testimony concerning his Son.

title: I John 5:10
text: He who believes on the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who does not believe God, has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has borne concerning his Son.

title: I John 5:11
text: And the testimony is this, "God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son."

title: I John 5:12
text: He who has the Son has the life; he who has not the Son of God has not the life.

title: I John 5:13
text: I have written these words to you so that you may know that you have eternal life, you who believe in the name of the Son of God.

title: I John 5:14
text: Now the confidence which we have in him is this, that he listens to us whenever we ask anything that is in accordance with his will.

title: I John 5:15
text: And if we know that he is listening to us in what ever we are asking, we know that we obtain the petitions which we have made to him.

title: I John 5:16
text: If any one sees his brother committing a sin that is not deadly, he shall ask, and God will give him life, for any one who is not committing a deadly sin. There is a deadly sin; concerning that I do not say that he should pray.

title: I John 5:17
text: All unrighteousness is sin; and there is sin that is not deadly.

title: I John 5:18
text: We know that whoever is a child of God is not habitually committing sin; but he who is God's child guards himself, and the Evil One never touches him.

title: I John 5:19
text: We know that we are of God, and the whole world is lying in the Evil One.

title: I John 5:20
text: And we know that the Son of God is come, and has granted us and understanding, so that we may come to know him who is true. And we are in him who is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and life eternal.

title: I John 5:21
text: My little children, guard yourselves from idols.

title: II John 1:1
text: The Elder to the Elect Lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all those who have come to know the truth.

title: II John 1:2
text: I love you for the sake of the truth which is abiding in us and will be with us forever.

title: II John 1:3
text: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ the Father's Son, in truth and love.

title: II John 1:4
text: I am greatly rejoiced to find some of your children leading their lives in truth, even as we received commandment from the Father.

title: II John 1:5
text: And now I am entreating you, Lady, not as though I were writing some new commandment to you, but one which we have had from the beginning, let us love one another.

title: II John 1:6
text: And this is love, that we should lead our lives according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should pass your life in love.

title: II John 1:7
text: I say this because many deceivers are gone forth into the world, those who deny the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

title: II John 1:8
text: Watch yourselves, that you do not lose what we have wrought, but that you receive a full reward.

title: II John 1:9
text: Whoever is going ahead, and is not abiding in the teachings of Christ, does not possess God; but he who is abiding in the teaching possesses both the Father and the Son.

title: II John 1:10
text: If any one come to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house, nor give him any greeting.

title: II John 1:11
text: For the man who greets him shares in his wicked work.

title: II John 1:12
text: I have many things to write to you, but I would not write them with paper and ink. I hope to come to you and to talk with you face to face, so that your joy may be full.

title: II John 1:13
text: The children of your elect sister send you greeting.

title: III John 1:1
text: The Elder to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

title: III John 1:2
text: I pray that you may prosper, beloved, in every way, and be in good health, even as your soul is prospering.

title: III John 1:3
text: For I was glad when brothers came and bore testimony to your truth, as indeed you are passing your life in truth.

title: III John 1:4
text: I have no greater joy than this, to hear that my children are passing their lives in the truth.

title: III John 1:5
text: You are acting faithfully, beloved, in whatever you are doing for the brothers and the strangers.

title: III John 1:6
text: They have borne testimony to your love before the church. You will do well to speed them on their way worthily of God;

title: III John 1:7
text: since for the sake of the Name they have started out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

title: III John 1:8
text: Hence we ought to support such, so that we may become fellow workers for the truth.

title: III John 1:9
text: I have written somewhat to the church; but Diotrephes, who love to take the lead among them, does not receive me.

title: III John 1:10
text: Do them when I come I will recall to mind the deeds which he is doing, prating against me with wicked words. Not satisfied with that, he refuses to receive the brothers, forbids those that would receive them, and excommunicates them from the church.

title: III John 1:11
text: Do not imitate what is evil, beloved, but that which is good. He who does good is of God; he who does evil has never gazed on God.

title: III John 1:12
text: All men bear testimony to Demetrius, and so does the truth itself. I also bear testimony to him; and you know that my testimony is true.

title: III John 1:13
text: I have a great deal to write to you, but I do not want to write you with pen and ink.

title: III John 1:14
text: I am hoping soon to see you, and then we shall talk face to face. Peace be to you! The friends send their salutation. Salute the friends by name.

title: Jude 1:1
text: Jude, a slave of Jesus Christ, and a brother of James: To those who are in God, the Father beloved, kept for Jesus Christ, and called.

title: Jude 1:2
text: May mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you.

title: Jude 1:3
text: Beloved, although I was making all haste to write to you in regard to our common salvation, I am compelled to write you an appeal to defend the faith once for all committed to the saints.

title: Jude 1:4
text: For certain men have crept in stealthily--men predestined in ancient prophecies for this condemnation--impious ones! They pervert the grace of our God into licentiousness, and deny Jesus Christ, our sole Master and Lord.

title: Jude 1:5
text: I wish to remind you of what you already know right well, that although the Lord once saved a people out of the land of Egypt, he afterward destroyed those who did not believe;

title: Jude 1:6
text: while the angels who did not keep their first domain but left their proper abode, are held by him in blank darkness, in everlasting chains, in preparation for the judgment of the Great Day.

title: Jude 1:7
text: So also Sodom and Gomorrah and the near-by cities which in like manner glutted themselves in sensuality and unnatural vice, are exhibited as a warning of the eternal fire, in the punishment they undergo.

title: Jude 1:8
text: Yet in just the same way these dreamers also defile the flesh, while they set at naught dominion and scoff at dignities.

title: Jude 1:9
text: But Michael, the Archangel, when in contending with the devil, he was disputing about the body of Moses, did not dare to pronounce sentence for blasphemy, but said, "The Lord rebuke you."

title: Jude 1:10
text: Yet these men blaspheme about matters of which they know nothing, while they use such things as they do understand by instinct (like the animals who have no reason) for their own destruction.

title: Jude 1:11
text: Alas for them! They have walked in the path of Cain; for the sake of gain they have rushed headlong into Balaam's error, and have perished in Korah's rebellion.

title: Jude 1:12
text: These are they who are stains upon your love-feasts; when they feast sumptuously without scruple, looking after none but themselves. They are clouds without water, driven along by the winds; trees of autumn, fruitless, doubly dead, torn up by the roots,

title: Jude 1:13
text: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom is reserved the blackness of darkness forever.

title: Jude 1:14
text: It was to these, too, that Enoch, the "seventh in descent from Adam," prophesied, saying, "Lo! the Lord is come with myriads of his saints,

title: Jude 1:15
text: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all the ungodly deeds which in their ungodliness they have committed; and of all the hard things which they have spoken against Him, ungodly sinners that they are!"

title: Jude 1:16
text: For these are murmurers, always complaining. They always go where their passions lead, and their mouth speaks great swelling words, while they pay court to men for the sake of the advantage they can get.

title: Jude 1:17
text: But as for you, dearly beloved, remember the words spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Jude 1:18
text: how they used to say to you, "In the last times there will be scoffers who will be led only by their godless passions."

title: Jude 1:19
text: These are the men, sensual and unspiritual, who cause divisions.

title: Jude 1:20
text: But you, beloved, continually building yourselves up on your most holy faith, and ever praying in the Holy Spirit,

title: Jude 1:21
text: must keep yourselves in the love of God, while waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, which ends in life eternal.

title: Jude 1:22
text: Pity some who are wavering, and save by dragging them out of the fire;

title: Jude 1:23
text: others pity, but with caution, hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

title: Jude 1:24
text: Now unto Him who has power to guard you from stumbling, and to make you stand in the presence of his glory, faultless and exultant,

title: Jude 1:25
text: to the only God, our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be ascribed glory, majesty, might, and authority, as it was before time began, is now, and ever shall be to all the ages. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:1
text: THE UNVEILING [APOCALYPSE] OF JESUS CHRIST which God gave him to show to his slaves the things which must soon come to pass; and he sent and made it known by his angel to his slave John.

title: Revelation of John 1:2
text: He bore witness of the Word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, even of all the things that he saw.

title: Revelation of John 1:3
text: Blessed is he who reads, and they who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep what is written in it. FOR THE CRISIS IS AT HAND.

title: Revelation of John 1:4
text: From John to the seven churches that are in Asia [the Roman Province]: Grace to you, and peace from Him that is and was and is to be, and from the Seven Spirits that are before his throne,

title: Revelation of John 1:5
text: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the Ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has loosed us from our sins in his own blood;

title: Revelation of John 1:6
text: and has made us to be a kingdom of priests unto his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever, Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:7
text: Behold, he is about to come among the clouds; and every eye will see him, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. So shall it be, Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:8
text: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 1:9
text: I, John, who am your brother and who share with you in the woes and kingdom and stedfastness of Jesus, found myself in the island called Patmos, for the sake of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 1:10
text: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard a loud voice behind me, like a trumpet,

title: Revelation of John 1:11
text: saying, "Write in a book what you see, and send it to the seven churches; to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamum and to Thyatira and Sardis and Philadelphia and Laodicea."

title: Revelation of John 1:12
text: And I turned to see the Voice which was speaking to me, and as I turned I saw seven golden candlesticks;

title: Revelation of John 1:13
text: and in the midst of the candlesticks One like to a son of man, clothed with a robe down to the feet, and with a golden girdle round his breast.

title: Revelation of John 1:14
text: His head and his hair were as white as wool, as white as snow; his eyes were like a flame of fire,

title: Revelation of John 1:15
text: and his feet like burnished brass, as if molten in a furnace; and his voice like the voice of many waters.

title: Revelation of John 1:16
text: In his right hand he held seven stars; and out of mouth went a sharp, two-edged sword, and his face was as the sun shining in his strength.

title: Revelation of John 1:17
text: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as one dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying: "Fear not; I am the first and the last, and the Living One.

title: Revelation of John 1:18
text: I was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore; and hold the keys of death and of Hades.

title: Revelation of John 1:19
text: So write the things which you saw, and the things which are, and the things that will come to pass hereafter.

title: Revelation of John 1:20
text: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks, is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven candlesticks are the seven churches."

title: Revelation of John 2:1
text: To the angel of the Church in Ephesus, write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in his right hand, and who walks among the seven golden candlesticks:

title: Revelation of John 2:2
text: I know your works and your toil and stedfastness, and that you cannot endure evil men, and that you tested those who called themselves apostles, though they are not, and how you found them false.

title: Revelation of John 2:3
text: You are holding fast, and have borne up for my names's sake, and have not grown weary.

title: Revelation of John 2:4
text: But I have this against you, that you have left your first love.

title: Revelation of John 2:5
text: Remember whence you have fallen, and turn again, and do your first works. Otherwise I am coming to you and will remove your candlestick out of its place, unless you repent.

title: Revelation of John 2:6
text: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I hate.

title: Revelation of John 2:7
text: He who has an ear, let him listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches. To him that overcomes, to him will I give to eat from the tree of life which is in the garden of God.

title: Revelation of John 2:8
text: And unto the angel of the Church in Smyrna, write: These are the words of the First and the Last, he who died and has returned to life:

title: Revelation of John 2:9
text: I know your persecution and your poverty--but you are rich! I know the reviling of those who say that they themselves are Jews, when they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

title: Revelation of John 2:10
text: Fear not what you are about to suffer! Behold, the devil is indeed going to put some of you in prison, that you may be tested, and you will have persecution for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

title: Revelation of John 2:11
text: Let him who has ears, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches: He that overcomes shall not be hurt of the second death.

title: Revelation of John 2:12
text: And to the angel of the Church in Pergamum, write These are the words of Him who holds the sharp two-edged sword:

title: Revelation of John 2:13
text: I know where you dwell, where the throne of Satan is; and yet you are holding fast my name, and you have not denied my faith, even in the days of Antipas, my witness, my faithful one, who was slain among you, where Satan has his dwelling.

title: Revelation of John 2:14
text: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling- block before the sons of Israel, to eat food offered to idols, and to practise immorality.

title: Revelation of John 2:15
text: So you have also some who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

title: Revelation of John 2:16
text: Repent; if you do not I will very soon come to you, and will make war upon them with the sword of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 2:17
text: He who has ears, let him listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches. To him that overcomes I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written, which no man knows, but he that receives it.

title: Revelation of John 2:18
text: And to the angel of the Church in Thyatira, write: These are the words of the Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet like burnished brass:

title: Revelation of John 2:19
text: I know your works and your love and faith and service and endurance; I know that your last works are more than the first.

title: Revelation of John 2:20
text: But I have this against you, that you are tolerating that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, and she is teaching and leading my slaves astray, leading them to practise immorality, and to eat food which has been sacrificed to idols.

title: Revelation of John 2:21
text: I have given her time for repentance; but she is determined not to turn from her immorality.

title: Revelation of John 2:22
text: Behold, I will lay her on a sick bed, and bring great distress upon those who have committed adultery with her, unless they turn away from her works.

title: Revelation of John 2:23
text: And moreover, her children will I kill with pestilence. And all the churches shall know that I am he who searches the hearts and souls of men. I will give to each of you according to his works.

title: Revelation of John 2:24
text: But to the rest of you in Thyatira, those who do not hold his teaching, and who do not know the "deep things" of Satan (as they call them),

title: Revelation of John 2:25
text: I say that I am imposing upon you no fresh burden; only hold fast what you have till I come.

title: Revelation of John 2:26
text: To him that overcomes and perseveres in my works to the end, will I give authority over the nations.

title: Revelation of John 2:27
text: And he shall shepherd them with a rod of iron, shattering them like earthen vessels (as I myself have received from my Father),

title: Revelation of John 2:28
text: and I will give him the Morning Star."

title: Revelation of John 2:29
text: Let him who has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:1
text: To the angel of the Church at Sardis, write: These things says He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I know your works, that you have the name of being alive, but are really dead.

title: Revelation of John 3:2
text: Be continually on the watch, and establish the things that remain, which were ready to die. For I have not found your works perfected before my God.

title: Revelation of John 3:3
text: Call to mind, then, what you have received and heard, and hold to it, and repent. Unless you are on the watch, I will come as a thief, and you will never know at what hour I am coming upon you.

title: Revelation of John 3:4
text: Yet you have a few names in Sardis that have not defiled their garment; and they shall walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

title: Revelation of John 3:5
text: He who overcomes shall thus be clad in white raiment; and I will in no wise blot out his name from the book of life, and I will own his name before my Father, and before his angels.

title: Revelation of John 3:6
text: Let him who has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:7
text: Write also to the angel of the Church in Philadelphia: These things says He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens, and no one shall shut; and who shuts, and no one opens:

title: Revelation of John 3:8
text: I know your works. Lo, I have set before you an open door, which none can shut; for though you have only a little strength, you have kept my word, and have not denied my name.

title: Revelation of John 3:9
text: Behold, I am making those of the synagogue of Satan, those who say they are Jews, but are not, but are lying; behold, I will make them to come and bow in reverence before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

title: Revelation of John 3:10
text: Because you have kept the word of my patience, I also will keep you from that hour of trial which is about to come upon the whole inhabited earth, to test those who dwell on the earth.

title: Revelation of John 3:11
text: I am coming quickly. Hold fast what you have, that no one may take your crown.

title: Revelation of John 3:12
text: He that overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God; and he shall go out from it nevermore. And I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which is coming down from my God out of heaven, and my own new name.

title: Revelation of John 3:13
text: He that has an ear, let him listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:14
text: To the angel of the Church in Laodicea, write: These things says the Amen, the witness, faithful and true, the beginning of the creation of God:

title: Revelation of John 3:15
text: I know your works, that you are neither hot nor cold.

title: Revelation of John 3:16
text: Would that you were either cold or hot. So because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I am about to spew you out of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 3:17
text: For you keep saying, "I am rich, and have become wealthy, and have need of nothing," and do not know that you are the wretched one, and pitiable and beggared and blind and naked.

title: Revelation of John 3:18
text: I advise you to buy of me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white raiment to clothe yourself, so that the shame of your nakedness may not be made manifest; and eye-salve to anoint your eyes, in order that you may see.

title: Revelation of John 3:19
text: All whom I love I reprove and discipline; therefore be full of zeal and repent.

title: Revelation of John 3:20
text: Behold, I am standing at the door and knocking! If any one listens to my voice, and opens the door, I will come to him, and sup with him, and he with me.

title: Revelation of John 3:21
text: To him who overcomes, I will grant to sit down with me on my throne, as I myself have overcome and have taken my seat with my Father on his throne.

title: Revelation of John 3:22
text: Let any one who has an ear listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 4:1
text: After this, in my vision, I saw a door opened in heaven! And the first voice that I heard speaking with me was like a trumpet, saying, "Come up hither, and I will show you the things that must come to pass hereafter."

title: Revelation of John 4:2
text: Immediately I was in the Spirit; and behold, there stood a throne in heaven, and upon the throne One sat;

title: Revelation of John 4:3
text: and he who sat was in appearance like a jasper stone and a sardius; and there was a rainbow round about the throne, like an emerald to look upon.

title: Revelation of John 4:4
text: And round about the throne were four and twenty Elders seated, who were clothed in white raiment, with golden crowns upon their heads.

title: Revelation of John 4:5
text: From the throne issued lightning and voices and thunders. Seven blazing lamps were burning before the throne; these are the seven Spirits of God.

title: Revelation of John 4:6
text: And in front of the throne as it seemed, a glassy sea like crystal; and in the midst of the throne and encircling it are four Living Creatures, full of eyes before and behind.

title: Revelation of John 4:7
text: The first creature was like a lion, and the second like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man's, and the fourth creature was like an eagle flying.

title: Revelation of John 4:8
text: And the four Living Creatures, each one with six wings, are full of eyes round about and within; day and night they are chanting ceaselessly. "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty. Who was, and who is, and who is to come."

title: Revelation of John 4:9
text: And whenever the Living Creatures give glory and honor and thanks to Him who sits on the throne, to Him who lives forever and ever,

title: Revelation of John 4:10
text: the four and twenty Elders fall down before Him who sits on the throne, and worship Him who lives forever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying:

title: Revelation of John 4:11
text: "Worthy art thou, our Lord and our God, To receive the glory and the honor and the power; For thou didst create all things, And because of thy will they came into being And were created."

title: Revelation of John 5:1
text: Then I saw lying upon the right hand of Him who sat upon the throne, a book written within and on the back, close sealed with seven seals.

title: Revelation of John 5:2
text: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose its seals."

title: Revelation of John 5:3
text: And no one in the heavens or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look into it.

title: Revelation of John 5:4
text: so I began to weep bitterly because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look into it.

title: Revelation of John 5:5
text: But one of the Elders said to me: "Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered, and so can open the book with its seven seals."

title: Revelation of John 5:6
text: Then I beheld a Lamb standing as if slain in the midst of the throne and of the four Living Creatures, and in the midst of the Elders. He had seven horns and seven eyes (which are the seven Spirits of God, sent forth into all the earth).

title: Revelation of John 5:7
text: And he went, and now he has taken the book out of the right hand of Him who was seated on the throne.

title: Revelation of John 5:8
text: When he took the book, the four Living Creatures and the four and twenty Elders fell down before the Lamb. And each had a harp and a golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

title: Revelation of John 5:9
text: And they sang a new song, saying, "Worthy art thou to take the book And to open its seals; For thou wast slain and didst ransom for God Men out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation;

title: Revelation of John 5:10
text: Thou hast made them kings and priests unto our God, And they shall reign on earth."

title: Revelation of John 5:11
text: Then I looked and heard a voice of many angels encircling the throne and a voice of the Living Creatures and of the Elders; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands,

title: Revelation of John 5:12
text: singing aloud, "Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain, To receive power and riches and wisdom And might and honor and glory and blessing."

title: Revelation of John 5:13
text: And I heard every created thing that is in heaven, or on earth, or beneath the earth, or on the sea, and all things that are in them, saying, "To him who sits on the throne, And to the Lamb, Be the blessing and the honor, And the glory and the power, Forever and ever!"

title: Revelation of John 5:14
text: And the four Living Creatures kept saying, "Amen!" And the Elders fell down and worshiped.

title: Revelation of John 6:1
text: And I saw, when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four Living Creatures say, with a voice like thunder, "Come!"

title: Revelation of John 6:2
text: And I saw, and lo, a white horse, and he who sat on him had a bow; and there was given him a crown; and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

title: Revelation of John 6:3
text: And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second Living Creature say, "Come!"

title: Revelation of John 6:4
text: And another horse come forth, a red horse. To him who sat on it, it was allowed to take peace from the earth, and to cause men to kill one another; and a great sword was given to him.

title: Revelation of John 6:5
text: And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third Living Creature say, "Come!" And I saw, and lo, a black horse! He who sat on him had a balance in his hand.

title: Revelation of John 6:6
text: And I heard the semblance of a voice in the midst of the four Living Creatures, saying: "A quart of wheat for a shilling, and three quarts of barley for a shilling; but do not harm the oil and the wine."

title: Revelation of John 6:7
text: And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth Living Creature calling, "Come!"

title: Revelation of John 6:8
text: So I liked, and lo, a pale horse; and he who sat on him was named Death; and Hades was following after him. To them was given authority over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with the sword, and with famine, and with death, and with the wild beasts of the earth.
